title: 计算机科学，从零搭建 · 第42部分：浏览器与 Web

chapters.Hook: 输入一个网址之后发生了什么
chapters.Outro: 回顾、习题，以及它们会在哪里再出现

468141fecf20.en: Type an address into a browser and press enter. In a few hundred milliseconds, a page appears. <bookmark mark='a'/> Between the key press and the pixels, almost everything this series has built takes a turn. The name is resolved by the domain name system of Part 36. A TCP connection is opened, and a TLS handshake agrees keys with the public-key cryptography of Part 30. <bookmark mark='b'/> The request goes out, and the first bytes of HTML come back over the transport protocols of Part 37. <bookmark mark='c'/> Then the browser's own work begins. It parses the HTML while it is still arriving, discovers stylesheets and scripts and fetches them in parallel, computes the style of every element, lays out the page, and paints it. <bookmark mark='d'/> That last stretch, from bytes to pixels, is this part's subject: what a browser does with a page once it has one.
468141fecf20.zh: 在浏览器里输入一个网址，按下回车。几百毫秒之后，一个页面出现了。<bookmark mark='a'/>从按下按键到像素出现，这个系列搭建过的几乎所有东西都要轮番上场。名字由第36部分的域名系统解析。接着建立一条 TCP 连接，再通过一次 TLS 握手，用第30部分的公钥密码学协商出密钥。<bookmark mark='b'/>请求发出去，HTML 的头几个字节经由第37部分的传输协议传回来。<bookmark mark='c'/>然后，浏览器自己的工作开始了。它一边接收 HTML 一边解析，发现样式表和脚本，并行地获取它们，计算每个元素的样式，对页面进行布局，再把它绘制出来。<bookmark mark='d'/>最后这一段，从字节到像素，就是这一部分的主题：浏览器拿到一个页面之后，要对它做些什么。

358bf901b156.en: A browser is several machines in one program. <bookmark mark='a'/> It is a parser that never rejects its input: every sequence of bytes, however broken, becomes a document tree. <bookmark mark='b'/> It is a constraint solver, fitting boxes, lines of text and free space together. It is a graphics compositor, moving and blending layers on the GPU sixty or a hundred and twenty times a second. <bookmark mark='c'/> It is a just-in-time compiler that makes untrusted code fast, and an operating system that keeps that code in a sandbox. <bookmark mark='d'/> And one event loop holds it all together, with a deadline: at sixty frames a second, everything for the next frame has to fit in sixteen point seven milliseconds.
358bf901b156.zh: 浏览器是装在一个程序里的好几台机器。<bookmark mark='a'/>它是一个从不拒绝输入的解析器：任何字节序列，不管多么残破，都会变成一棵文档树。<bookmark mark='b'/>它是一个约束求解器，把盒子、一行行文字和空白空间拼合在一起。它是一个图形合成器，每秒60次或120次，在 GPU 上移动和混合图层。<bookmark mark='c'/>它是一个即时编译器，让不受信任的代码跑得飞快；它也是一个操作系统，把这些代码关在沙箱里。<bookmark mark='d'/>而把这一切维系在一起的，是一个事件循环，它有一个截止时间：每秒60帧时，下一帧的所有工作都必须挤进16.7毫秒。

2abc4f6d1272.en: We will build each stage, small enough to read, and at the end run them together as a toy browser. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here is its output: the top of this series' own README. <bookmark mark='b'/> The Markdown becomes HTML; a tokenizer and a tree builder turn the HTML into a tree of 146 nodes; the cascade gives every element a style; layout breaks the text into lines and stacks the blocks; and a painter draws the words with real fonts into real pixels. <bookmark mark='c'/> It is missing almost everything a real browser has. But each piece does what the real piece does, and it shows the shape of the problem.
2abc4f6d1272.zh: 我们会把每个阶段都搭建出来，小到足以通读，最后把它们一起运行，组成一个玩具浏览器。<bookmark mark='a'/>这是它的输出：这个系列自己的 README 的开头。<bookmark mark='b'/>Markdown 变成 HTML；一个分词器和一个树构建器把 HTML 变成一棵有146个节点的树；层叠给每个元素一个样式；布局把文字断成行，再把块堆叠起来；最后，一个绘制器用真实的字体，把文字画成真实的像素。<bookmark mark='c'/>真正的浏览器有的东西，它几乎都没有。但每一个部件都做着真实部件所做的事，它展示了这个问题的形状。

81219153e18b.en: This is Part 42 of Computer Science, Built, the third part of Act Eight. <bookmark mark='a'/> We will see why HTML is parsed by a state machine rather than a grammar; how the cascade decides which style wins; how a page is laid out, down to the dynamic program that breaks a paragraph into lines; how the event loop schedules everything into frames; what a JavaScript engine does to make dynamic code fast; and how frameworks, caches, the security model and accessibility rest on all of it.
81219153e18b.zh: 这是计算机科学，从零搭建，第42部分，也是第八幕的第三部分。<bookmark mark='a'/>我们会看到：为什么 HTML 是用状态机而不是用文法来解析的；层叠如何决定哪条样式胜出；页面如何布局，一直深入到把一个段落断成行的动态规划；事件循环如何把一切调度进一帧一帧里；JavaScript 引擎做了什么，让动态代码跑得快；以及框架、缓存、安全模型和无障碍，如何全都建立在这一切之上。

7d14fc6575e8.en: Chapter one. Thirty years of the web.

f2e75889a389.en: In March 1989 Tim Berners-Lee, at CERN, proposed keeping track of the laboratory's information as documents linked to one another. His supervisor wrote on the cover: vague, but exciting. <bookmark mark='a'/> By the end of 1990 he had built the three pieces still underneath every page: a name for any document, which became the URL; a protocol for fetching it, HTTP; and a format with links, HTML. <bookmark mark='b'/> He wrote the first browser, called WorldWideWeb, on a NeXT computer, and the first server. <bookmark mark='c'/> In August 1991 he announced the project to the world.
f2e75889a389.zh: 1989年3月，CERN 的蒂姆·伯纳斯-李（Tim Berners-Lee）提议，把实验室的信息作为相互链接的文档来管理。他的上司在封面上写道：含糊，但令人兴奋。<bookmark mark='a'/>到1990年底，他已经做出了至今仍垫在每个页面底下的三件东西：任何文档都有一个名字，后来成了 URL；一个获取文档的协议，HTTP；还有一种带链接的格式，HTML。<bookmark mark='b'/>他在一台 NeXT 计算机上写出了第一个浏览器，名叫 WorldWideWeb，还写出了第一个服务器。<bookmark mark='c'/>1991年8月，他向全世界宣布了这个项目。

7ce729e2fd74.en: The web spread when it became pleasant to look at. <bookmark mark='a'/> In 1993 Marc Andreessen and Eric Bina, at the National Center for Supercomputing Applications, released Mosaic, whose image tag put pictures in the page itself, among the words. <bookmark mark='b'/> That April, CERN put the web's software in the public domain. <bookmark mark='c'/> In 1994 Andreessen co-founded Netscape, whose Navigator soon dominated, and Berners-Lee founded the World Wide Web Consortium, the W3C, to write the standards.
7ce729e2fd74.zh: Web 变得赏心悦目之后，就传播开了。<bookmark mark='a'/>1993年，美国国家超级计算应用中心的马克·安德森（Marc Andreessen）和 Eric Bina 发布了 Mosaic，它的图像标签把图片放进了页面本身，夹在文字之间。<bookmark mark='b'/>同年4月，CERN 把 Web 的软件放进了公有领域。<bookmark mark='c'/>1994年，安德森参与创办了 Netscape，它的 Navigator 很快占据了统治地位；伯纳斯-李则创立了万维网联盟，也就是 W3C，来编写标准。

0722fa379c15.en: Two more languages joined HTML. <bookmark mark='a'/> In October 1994 Håkon Wium Lie proposed cascading style sheets, so that how a page looks could be written apart from what it says. CSS level one became a W3C recommendation in December 1996. <bookmark mark='b'/> In May 1995, at Netscape, Brendan Eich wrote the first JavaScript in about ten days. It was standardized as ECMAScript in 1997, and some of its hasty decisions are with us still. <bookmark mark='c'/> Microsoft answered with Internet Explorer, bundled with Windows. In the browser wars each side invented its own tags, and by the early two-thousands Internet Explorer had most of the market, and its development slowed.
0722fa379c15.zh: 又有两门语言加入了 HTML。<bookmark mark='a'/>1994年10月，Håkon Wium Lie 提出了层叠样式表，让页面的外观可以和它的内容分开来写。CSS 第一级在1996年12月成为 W3C 推荐标准。<bookmark mark='b'/>1995年5月，在 Netscape，布兰登·艾克（Brendan Eich）用大约10天写出了第一个 JavaScript。它在1997年以 ECMAScript 的名字标准化，它的一些仓促决定至今还跟着我们。<bookmark mark='c'/>微软的回应是 Internet Explorer，与 Windows 捆绑在一起。在浏览器大战中，双方各自发明自己的标签；到2000年代初，Internet Explorer 占据了大部分市场，它的开发也随之放缓。

dc741846dd82.en: The next leap came from a feature that almost nobody noticed. <bookmark mark='a'/> A classic page asks the server for a whole new page on every click. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 1999 Internet Explorer 5 shipped an object that let a script fetch data without leaving the page, and other browsers copied it as XMLHttpRequest. Now a page could stay put and fetch small pieces of data in the background. <bookmark mark='c'/> Gmail in 2004 and Google Maps in 2005 showed what that allowed, and in February 2005 Jesse James Garrett named the technique Ajax, for asynchronous JavaScript and XML.
dc741846dd82.zh: 下一次飞跃，来自一个几乎没人注意到的功能。<bookmark mark='a'/>经典的页面每点击一次，就向服务器要一整个新页面。<bookmark mark='b'/>1999年，Internet Explorer 5 带来了一个对象，让脚本不离开页面就能获取数据，其他浏览器以 XMLHttpRequest 的名字照搬了它。现在，页面可以待在原地，在后台获取一小块一小块的数据。<bookmark mark='c'/>2004年的 Gmail 和2005年的 Google Maps 展示了这带来的可能；2005年2月，Jesse James Garrett 把这种技术命名为 Ajax，意思是异步 JavaScript 和 XML。

c2da4118e1fe.en: Competition came back. <bookmark mark='a'/> Apple released Safari, on its WebKit engine, in 2003, and Mozilla released Firefox 1.0 in November 2004. <bookmark mark='b'/> In September 2008 Google released Chrome, with two ideas. Its engine, V8, compiled JavaScript to machine code, the just-in-time compilation of Part 15, and began a race that made JavaScript many times faster. <bookmark mark='c'/> And where browsers had run every page in one process, so that one bad page could take down them all, Chrome gave each tab, roughly, a process of its own: the isolation of Part 31.
c2da4118e1fe.zh: 竞争又回来了。<bookmark mark='a'/>苹果在2003年发布了基于 WebKit 引擎的 Safari，Mozilla 在2004年11月发布了 Firefox 1.0。<bookmark mark='b'/>2008年9月，谷歌发布了 Chrome，带来了两个想法。它的引擎 V8 把 JavaScript 编译成机器码，也就是第15部分的即时编译，并掀起了一场竞赛，让 JavaScript 快了许多倍。<bookmark mark='c'/>另外，过去的浏览器把所有页面放在一个进程里运行，一个坏页面就能把它们全部拖垮；Chrome 则大致上给每个标签页一个自己的进程：这就是第31部分的隔离。

0ca289b0ca19.en: The standards, meanwhile, had stalled. <bookmark mark='a'/> The W3C published numbered versions of HTML through the nineties, and then XHTML, which, served as XML, treated a single error as fatal, though real pages were full of errors. <bookmark mark='b'/> In June 2004 people from Apple, Mozilla and Opera founded the WHATWG, to extend HTML as browsers really used it. Their HTML5 said, for the first time, exactly how to parse any page, valid or not, and the W3C published it in 2014. <bookmark mark='c'/> In May 2019 the two bodies agreed on one HTML: the WHATWG's living standard, edited continuously, with no version numbers. Its parser is next.
0ca289b0ca19.zh: 与此同时，标准停滞了。<bookmark mark='a'/>整个九十年代，W3C 发布了一个个带编号的 HTML 版本，然后是 XHTML；它作为 XML 提供时，一个错误就是致命的，可真实的页面满是错误。<bookmark mark='b'/>2004年6月，来自苹果、Mozilla 和 Opera 的人创立了 WHATWG，按照浏览器真正使用 HTML 的方式来扩展它。他们的 HTML5 第一次准确规定了如何解析任何页面，无论它合法与否；W3C 在2014年发布了它。<bookmark mark='c'/>2019年5月，两个组织在同一个 HTML 上达成一致：WHATWG 的活标准（living standard），持续编辑，没有版本号。接下来要讲的，就是它的解析器。

b732ecbe1115.en: An HTML parser has two stages. The first, the tokenizer, is a finite automaton like those of Part 12, reading one character at a time. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here it reads a paragraph with a class, a word, and a bold word that is never closed. In the data state, characters are text. A less-than sign moves it to tag open, a letter to tag name, a space to the attributes, an equals sign to a value, and each greater-than sign back to data, emitting a token. <bookmark mark='b'/> Out come five tokens. <bookmark mark='c'/> Nothing here can fail: an unexpected character has a transition too, written down by the standard, whose tokenizer has about eighty states.
b732ecbe1115.zh: HTML 解析器分两个阶段。第一个阶段是分词器（tokenizer），它是一个有限自动机，就像第12部分里的那些，一次读一个字符。<bookmark mark='a'/>这里它读入一个带 class 的段落、一个词，以及一个从未闭合的粗体词。在数据状态下，字符就是文本。一个小于号把它带到标签打开状态，一个字母带到标签名状态，一个空格带到属性，一个等号带到属性值，而每个大于号都让它回到数据状态，并发出一个记号（token）。<bookmark mark='b'/>出来的是5个记号。<bookmark mark='c'/>这里没有什么会失败：意外的字符也有一条转移，由标准写明；标准的分词器大约有80个状态。

f5e2ddc8d4f2.en: The second stage, the tree builder, keeps a stack of open elements, the memory that Part 12 added to automata to handle nesting. <bookmark mark='a'/> A start tag creates an element, attaches it to the element on top of the stack, and pushes it; text is attached to the top. <bookmark mark='b'/> Then the paragraph's end tag arrives while bold is still open. A grammar would reject the input here. The tree builder pops bold too, closing it for the author, and then the paragraph. <bookmark mark='c'/> What remains is the DOM, the document object model: a tree of node objects that scripts read and change, and that everything else in this part works from.
f5e2ddc8d4f2.zh: 第二个阶段是树构建器，它维护一个开放元素栈，也就是第12部分为了处理嵌套而给自动机加上的那种存储。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个开始标签创建一个元素，把它挂到栈顶元素下面，再把它压入栈；文本则挂到栈顶元素下面。<bookmark mark='b'/>接着，段落的结束标签到来了，而粗体还开着。文法会在这里拒绝输入。树构建器则把粗体也弹出，替作者把它闭合，然后再闭合段落。<bookmark mark='c'/>剩下的就是 DOM，文档对象模型：一棵由节点对象组成的树，脚本读取和修改它，这一部分其余的一切也都以它为基础。

6d6c92eed895.en: Most of the tree builder's rules close elements the author left open. <bookmark mark='a'/> A paragraph cannot contain a paragraph, so a p start tag closes the open p, and the two become siblings. <bookmark mark='b'/> A list item closes the previous item, and the end of the list closes the last one. <bookmark mark='c'/> An end tag closes everything above its match on the stack: the end of the table ends the cell and the row too. A real browser also inserts a table body element here, which our simplified parser leaves out. The standard writes all of these rules down.
6d6c92eed895.zh: 树构建器的大多数规则，是替作者闭合那些没有关上的元素。<bookmark mark='a'/>段落里不能包含段落，所以一个 p 开始标签会闭合已打开的 p，两者成为兄弟。<bookmark mark='b'/>一个列表项会闭合前一个列表项，列表的结束会闭合最后一个。<bookmark mark='c'/>一个结束标签会闭合栈上位于它的匹配元素之上的一切：表格的结束同时结束了单元格和行。真正的浏览器还会在这里插入一个表格主体元素，我们简化过的解析器省掉了它。所有这些规则，标准都写了下来。

ad84bb826bea.en: Misnested tags are harder. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here bold opens, then italic, but bold closes first. Our tree builder closes the italic along with the bold, then opens a new italic element, so the last words stay italic, as the author meant: a simplified case of the standard's adoption agency algorithm. <bookmark mark='b'/> An end tag with nothing to match, like this stray span, is ignored. <bookmark mark='c'/> And a less-than sign that does not begin a tag is a parse error with a defined outcome: it is text. Every input gives a tree, and every browser that follows the standard gives the same one.
ad84bb826bea.zh: 错误嵌套的标签更难对付。<bookmark mark='a'/>这里先打开粗体，再打开斜体，但粗体先闭合。我们的树构建器把斜体连同粗体一起闭合，然后打开一个新的斜体元素，于是最后几个词仍是斜体，正如作者的本意：这是标准里收养代理算法（adoption agency algorithm）的一个简化情形。<bookmark mark='b'/>一个没有东西可匹配的结束标签，比如这个多余的 span，会被忽略。<bookmark mark='c'/>而一个并不开始标签的小于号，是一个有明确结果的解析错误：它就是文本。每一个输入都会得到一棵树，而每一个遵循标准的浏览器都会得到同一棵。

ea1bbc93bd6d.en: So why not write a grammar for HTML, and use the parsers of Parts 12 and 13? <bookmark mark='a'/> A parser built from a grammar also answers yes or no: input outside the language is a syntax error, and a compiler stops. A browser cannot stop. Real pages are full of errors, and a reader blames the browser that shows nothing. <bookmark mark='b'/> So the standard defines HTML by its parsing algorithm: a tokenizer of about eighty states, and a tree builder whose every step depends on its stack and on an insertion mode, such as in body or in table. <bookmark mark='c'/> Nor is the input fixed. A script running in the middle of parsing can call document dot write and insert new characters right after itself, so the parser must pause, run the script, and carry on.
ea1bbc93bd6d.zh: 那么，为什么不给 HTML 写一个文法，再用第12和第13部分的解析器呢？<bookmark mark='a'/>由文法构建的解析器也会回答是或否：语言之外的输入就是语法错误，编译器会停下来。浏览器不能停。真实的页面满是错误，而读者会怪罪那个什么都不显示的浏览器。<bookmark mark='b'/>所以，标准用解析算法来定义 HTML：一个大约80个状态的分词器，加上一个树构建器，它的每一步都取决于它的栈和一个插入模式，比如 in body 或 in table。<bookmark mark='c'/>输入也不是固定的。一个在解析途中运行的脚本可以调用 document.write，在它自己后面紧接着插入新的字符，所以解析器必须暂停，运行脚本，然后接着来。

3b10af69a647.en: When rules disagree about a property, the cascade decides which one wins, and its best-known tool is specificity. <bookmark mark='a'/> A selector's specificity is three counts: its ids, its classes, and its tag names. Here are ten selectors, weakest first. <bookmark mark='b'/> The counts are compared like words in a dictionary: ids first, classes only if the ids tie, tags last. So one id beats any number of classes. <bookmark mark='c'/> When two selectors tie exactly, like p dot lead and dot note p, the later rule wins.
3b10af69a647.zh: 当多条规则对同一个属性意见不一时，由层叠决定哪一条胜出，它最有名的工具是优先级（specificity）。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个选择器的优先级是三个计数：它的 id 数、类数和标签名数。这里有10个选择器，从弱到强排列。<bookmark mark='b'/>这些计数像字典里的词那样比较：先比 id，id 打平才比类，最后比标签。所以一个 id 胜过任意多个类。<bookmark mark='c'/>当两个选择器完全打平时，比如 p.lead 和 .note p，后出现的规则胜出。

70a7864dc2f3.en: Specificity is only part of the cascade's sort key. <bookmark mark='a'/> First comes origin and importance: the browser's defaults, then the user's style sheet, then the author's, with important declarations in reverse, so a user's important preferences beat the page. <bookmark mark='b'/> Then specificity, with a style attribute beating every selector. <bookmark mark='c'/> Then order of appearance. <bookmark mark='d'/> Sort every matching declaration by that key, and the last one wins. Cascade layers, in browsers since 2022, add a step, but not a new idea.
70a7864dc2f3.zh: 优先级只是层叠排序键的一部分。<bookmark mark='a'/>排在最前面的是来源和重要性：浏览器的默认样式，然后是用户的样式表，然后是作者的样式表；而 !important 声明的次序反过来，所以用户的 !important 偏好胜过页面。<bookmark mark='b'/>然后是优先级，style 属性胜过所有选择器。<bookmark mark='c'/>然后是出现的顺序。<bookmark mark='d'/>按这个键给所有匹配的声明排序，最后一个胜出。层叠层（cascade layers）从2022年起进入浏览器，它增加了一步，但没有带来新的思想。

cb3384a8e8f6.en: Now a small page with four rules. <bookmark mark='a'/> Four selectors match the paragraph of class lead. Sorted by specificity, then by order, three of them set its colour, and the last, the one with an id, wins. <bookmark mark='b'/> So the paragraph is green, and from p dot lead it takes a font size of eighteen pixels. <bookmark mark='c'/> The bold element inside matches no rule, but colour and font size are inherited: with no value of its own, an element takes its parent's, so the bold word is green too. <bookmark mark='d'/> The plain paragraph matches only p, and is grey.
cb3384a8e8f6.zh: 现在来看一个有4条规则的小页面。<bookmark mark='a'/>有4个选择器匹配 class 为 lead 的段落。先按优先级、再按顺序排序，其中3个设置了它的颜色，而最后那个，带 id 的那个，胜出。<bookmark mark='b'/>所以这个段落是绿色的，它还从 p.lead 那里得到了18像素的字号。<bookmark mark='c'/>里面的粗体元素不匹配任何规则，但颜色和字号是继承的：一个元素自己没有值时，就取父元素的值，所以粗体词也是绿色的。<bookmark mark='d'/>那个普通段落只匹配 p，是灰色的。

96f86cb5a83b.en: The DOM says what the page contains, <bookmark mark='a'/> and the parsed style sheets form the CSS object model, the CSSOM. <bookmark mark='b'/> Matching one against the other gives every element its computed style, and the result is the render tree, which Chrome now calls the layout tree: one entry for each element that will be drawn. <bookmark mark='c'/> An element with display none gets no entry, and a pseudo-element such as before gets one that the DOM lacks. Layout works on this tree.
96f86cb5a83b.zh: DOM 说明页面包含什么，<bookmark mark='a'/>而解析后的样式表构成 CSS 对象模型，也就是 CSSOM。<bookmark mark='b'/>把两者相互匹配，就给了每个元素它的计算样式，结果就是渲染树，Chrome 现在称之为布局树：每个要被绘制的元素都在其中有一项。<bookmark mark='c'/>display 为 none 的元素没有对应的项，而像 ::before 这样的伪元素，却有一项 DOM 里所没有的。布局就在这棵树上进行。

1c683383a71e.en: Matching rules to elements is the expensive part of style, and browsers do it backwards. <bookmark mark='a'/> To test div dot nav a against a link, start at the right: is this element an a? Yes. Then walk up its ancestors for one of class nav, and above that, a div. <bookmark mark='b'/> Most elements fail the first test. Left to right would start from every div and search everything below it. <bookmark mark='c'/> On a synthetic page of two thousand elements, with a mean depth of about 21, our ten selectors cost about 34 thousand element tests right to left, against 119 thousand left to right. <bookmark mark='d'/> On this series' shallow README the two are about equal, and left to right is even slightly cheaper: depth makes the difference.
1c683383a71e.zh: 把规则和元素匹配起来，是样式计算中代价高的部分，而浏览器是倒着做的。<bookmark mark='a'/>要用 div.nav a 去测试一个链接，就从右边开始：这个元素是 a 吗？是。然后沿着它的祖先往上走，找一个 class 为 nav 的，再往上，找一个 div。<bookmark mark='b'/>大多数元素在第一项测试就失败了。从左到右的话，就要从每一个 div 出发，搜索它下面的所有东西。<bookmark mark='c'/>在一个有2000个元素、平均深度约为21的合成页面上，我们的10个选择器从右到左大约要做34千次元素测试，而从左到右要做119千次。<bookmark mark='d'/>在这个系列那份很浅的 README 上，两者差不多，从左到右甚至还稍微便宜一点：造成差别的是深度。

bfa6f640331c.en: Most of those tests are never made, thanks to Part 17's hash maps. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each rule is filed under the rightmost part of its selector: its id, or else a class, or else its tag. <bookmark mark='b'/> To style a paragraph of class lead, look up only the buckets for p, for lead, and for the universal selector: six of these ten rules are tried, and the other four are never looked at. <bookmark mark='c'/> Engines also keep a Bloom filter, from Part 20, of the ancestors' ids, classes and tags, so a selector needing an ancestor of class nav is often rejected at once.
bfa6f640331c.zh: 这些测试大多数根本不会进行，这要归功于第17部分的哈希表。<bookmark mark='a'/>每条规则都按它的选择器最右边的部分归档：它的 id；没有 id 就用一个类；再没有就用它的标签。<bookmark mark='b'/>要给一个 class 为 lead 的段落计算样式，只需查找 p、lead 和通配选择器这几个桶：这十条规则中，只尝试其中六条，其余四条根本不会被看一眼。<bookmark mark='c'/>引擎还维护一个第20部分的布隆过滤器，记录祖先的 id、类和标签，所以一个需要 class 为 nav 的祖先的选择器，常常立刻就被排除。

ac81c05b16e7.en: Layout gives every element a box: where it goes, and how big it is. <bookmark mark='a'/> A box is its content, then padding, a border, and a margin that keeps neighbours away. <bookmark mark='b'/> In normal flow, blocks stack down the page, each as wide as its container: widths flow down the tree, heights come back up. <bookmark mark='c'/> Inside a block, inline boxes flow along a line and wrap into the next line box.
ac81c05b16e7.zh: 布局给每个元素一个盒子：它放在哪里，有多大。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个盒子由内容、内边距、边框，以及让邻居保持距离的外边距组成。<bookmark mark='b'/>在常规流中，块沿着页面向下堆叠，每个块都和它的容器一样宽：宽度沿着树向下传递，高度再向上返回。<bookmark mark='c'/>在一个块内部，行内盒沿着一行排列，排不下就折到下一个行盒里。

ea22104c305e.en: Flexbox shares out space. <bookmark mark='a'/> Three items with bases of one hundred and twenty, two hundred and one hundred and sixty pixels, and grow factors of one, two and zero, fill four hundred and eighty pixels. <bookmark mark='b'/> At seven hundred and twenty, two hundred and forty pixels are free: one share to the first, two to the second, none to the third. <bookmark mark='c'/> At eight hundred and eighty, four hundred are shared the same way. <bookmark mark='d'/> At three hundred and sixty, a hundred and twenty are missing, taken in proportion to shrink factor times basis, so the widest gives up most. <bookmark mark='e'/> At three hundred, each loses three eighths. <bookmark mark='f'/> Items that hit a size limit are frozen, and the rest share again.
ea22104c305e.zh: 弹性盒布局（Flexbox）负责分配空间。<bookmark mark='a'/>3个项目，基准尺寸分别是120、200和160像素，增长因子分别是1、2和0，正好填满480像素。<bookmark mark='b'/>在720像素时，有240像素空余：第一个分得一份，第二个分得两份，第三个没有。<bookmark mark='c'/>在880像素时，400像素按同样的方式分配。<bookmark mark='d'/>在360像素时，缺了120像素，按收缩因子乘以基准尺寸的比例扣除，所以最宽的那个让出的最多。<bookmark mark='e'/>在300像素时，每个都缩小八分之三。<bookmark mark='f'/>碰到尺寸限制的项目被冻结，其余的再重新分配。

d60c0257d28b.en: Grid is the two-dimensional version. <bookmark mark='a'/> Columns and rows are tracks, and items span the grid lines between them. <bookmark mark='b'/> A track can be fixed, or a fraction of what is left: in eight hundred pixels, a fixed two hundred leaves six hundred, so one fraction is two hundred. <bookmark mark='c'/> Rows and columns are sized together, so items line up both ways.
d60c0257d28b.zh: 网格布局（Grid）是它的二维版本。<bookmark mark='a'/>列和行都是轨道，项目跨越它们之间的网格线。<bookmark mark='b'/>一条轨道可以是固定的，也可以是剩余空间的一份：在800像素里，固定的200像素留下600像素，所以一份就是200像素。<bookmark mark='c'/>行和列是一起确定尺寸的，所以项目在两个方向上都能对齐。

12581311043a.en: How should a paragraph break into lines? <bookmark mark='a'/> The greedy rule, which browsers have traditionally used, puts each word on the current line if it fits. Here is Darcy's letter from Pride and Prejudice at three hundred and sixty pixels; red bars show each line's shortfall. <bookmark mark='b'/> Knuth and Plass, in 1981, for TeX, chose all the breaks at once, minimising the sum of the lines' cubed shortfalls. <bookmark mark='c'/> Both use seventeen lines and differ on three. Greedy's worst line is seventy-seven point eight pixels short, against fifty-four point eight, and badness falls from two point four to one point eight six. <bookmark mark='d'/> Over three hundred paragraphs of the novel, total fit wins on two hundred and eighty-four.
12581311043a.zh: 一个段落应该怎样断成行？<bookmark mark='a'/>贪心规则是浏览器传统上使用的方法：只要放得下，就把每个词放在当前行上。这是《傲慢与偏见》里达西的信，宽度为360像素；红条显示每一行的欠缺量。<bookmark mark='b'/>1981年，高德纳（Knuth）和 Plass 为 TeX 一次性选定所有断点，使各行欠缺量的立方和最小。<bookmark mark='c'/>两种方法都用了17行，其中有3行不同。贪心最差的一行差了77.8像素，而另一种是54.8像素；劣度（badness）从2.4降到1.86。<bookmark mark='d'/>在这部小说的300个段落中，整体最优（total fit）在284个上胜出。

5fc303dad662.en: Knuth and Plass saw this as a graph. <bookmark mark='a'/> Put a node between every two words of the novel's opening sentence, and an edge wherever the words between two nodes fit on a line of one hundred and ninety pixels: eighty-seven edges, each weighted by its line's badness. <bookmark mark='b'/> The best paragraph is the cheapest path from first node to last, found by the dynamic programming of Part 19: the best cost to each node from the best costs before it. Its total is five point four one. <bookmark mark='c'/> Greedy squeezes that a onto line two and is left with a third line far too short: eight point five three. Locally best is globally worse.
5fc303dad662.zh: 高德纳和 Plass 把这看成一个图。<bookmark mark='a'/>在这部小说开头一句的每两个词之间放一个节点；只要两个节点之间的词能放进190像素宽的一行，就连一条边：一共87条边，每条边以它那一行的劣度为权重。<bookmark mark='b'/>最好的段落，就是从第一个节点到最后一个节点的最便宜路径，用第19部分的动态规划求出：到每个节点的最优代价，由它之前各节点的最优代价得出。它的总代价是5.41。<bookmark mark='c'/>贪心把那个 a 挤到第二行，结果留下一个短得多的第三行：8.53。局部最优，在全局上反而更差。

94d7d179bbab.en: Laying out the whole page on every change would waste the frame. <bookmark mark='a'/> So engines keep dirty bits: an edit marks its box, and a bit saying a child needs layout climbs to the root. <bookmark mark='b'/> Layout walks only the marked path. Editing one paragraph of our toy browser's README re-breaks its twenty-two words and moves the eleven blocks below; the rest of the seven hundred and eighty-six words are untouched. <bookmark mark='c'/> The catch: reading a size from script forces pending layout at once, so alternating reads and writes lays out the page again and again.
94d7d179bbab.zh: 每次改动都把整个页面重新布局，会浪费这一帧的时间。<bookmark mark='a'/>所以引擎会保留脏位：一次编辑标记它的盒子，一个表示“有子节点需要布局”的位会一路爬到根。<bookmark mark='b'/>布局只沿着被标记的路径走。在我们玩具浏览器的 README 里编辑一个段落，会重新断开它的22个词，并移动它下面的11个块；786个词中其余的都不受影响。<bookmark mark='c'/>问题在于：从脚本里读取一个尺寸，会立刻强制执行待处理的布局，所以交替地读和写，会让页面一遍又一遍地重新布局。

bf050a8505d1.en: Chapter five. Paint, layers and the frame.

8a82f80ef88d.en: With every box placed, the browser still has to make pixels, and it does so in a pipeline. <bookmark mark='a'/> Style computes the properties of every element. Layout places the boxes. Paint walks the box tree and records what to draw. Composite combines the results into a frame. <bookmark mark='b'/> Paint does not set pixels directly. It produces a display list, drawing commands in the order CSS defines: backgrounds and borders first, then text, then positioned elements by their stacking order. <bookmark mark='c'/> Turning that list into pixels, in tiles and usually on the graphics processor, is rasterisation, the subject of Part 51.
8a82f80ef88d.zh: 每个盒子都摆好之后，浏览器还得生成像素，它用一条流水线来完成。<bookmark mark='a'/>样式计算每个元素的属性。布局摆放盒子。绘制遍历盒子树，记录下要画什么。合成把结果组合成一帧。<bookmark mark='b'/>绘制并不直接设置像素。它产生一个显示列表，也就是按 CSS 规定的次序排列的绘图命令：先是背景和边框，然后是文字，再按层叠次序画定位元素。<bookmark mark='c'/>把这个列表变成像素，分成图块、通常在图形处理器上完成，这叫光栅化，是第51部分的主题。

de7452bffaac.en: Browsers do not repaint the whole page for every change. <bookmark mark='a'/> They split it into layers: here the page, a header that stays put while the page scrolls, and a card being animated. Each layer is rastered once into a texture, and the compositor stacks the textures on the graphics processor. <bookmark mark='b'/> Animate a property such as width, and every frame goes through style, layout, paint and composite. Animate transform or opacity instead, and nothing about the boxes changes: the compositor just moves or fades a texture. <bookmark mark='c'/> It runs on its own thread, so such an animation keeps running even while a script is busy. <bookmark mark='d'/> Layers are not free, though: each is a texture in memory, and a page that asks for too many runs short.
de7452bffaac.zh: 浏览器不会为每一次改动都重绘整个页面。<bookmark mark='a'/>它们把页面分成图层：这里是页面本身、一个在页面滚动时保持不动的页眉，以及一张正在做动画的卡片。每个图层只光栅化一次，变成一张纹理，合成器在图形处理器上把这些纹理叠起来。<bookmark mark='b'/>给 width 这样的属性做动画，每一帧都要经过样式、布局、绘制和合成。改成给 transform 或 opacity 做动画，盒子就什么都没变：合成器只是移动或淡化一张纹理。<bookmark mark='c'/>合成器运行在自己的线程上，所以即使脚本正忙，这样的动画也会继续运行。<bookmark mark='d'/>不过图层不是免费的：每个图层都是内存里的一张纹理，一个要求太多图层的页面会把内存用光。

45a7f2df2955.en: All of this has a deadline. <bookmark mark='a'/> A sixty hertz display shows a new frame every sixteen point seven milliseconds; on a hundred and twenty hertz screen, every eight point three. <bookmark mark='b'/> Everything for a frame, scripts, style, layout and paint, has to fit in that window. In our simulator a frame's rendering step takes four milliseconds, leaving about twelve and a half for everything else. <bookmark mark='c'/> To animate in step with the display, a page asks for requestAnimationFrame. Its callback runs once, just before the next frame's style and layout, and receives that frame's time. A timer set to sixteen milliseconds drifts against the display instead, and the browser pauses animation frames in background tabs.
45a7f2df2955.zh: 这一切都有一个截止时间。<bookmark mark='a'/>60赫兹的显示器每16.7毫秒显示一帧新画面；在120赫兹的屏幕上，是每8.3毫秒一帧。<bookmark mark='b'/>一帧里的所有事情，脚本、样式、布局和绘制，都必须装进这个时间窗口。在我们的模拟器里，一帧的渲染步骤要花4毫秒，留给其他一切的大约是12.5毫秒。<bookmark mark='c'/>为了和显示器同步地做动画，页面会请求 requestAnimationFrame。它的回调只运行一次，就在下一帧的样式和布局之前，并且会收到那一帧的时间。而设为16毫秒的定时器，则会相对显示器逐渐漂移；另外，浏览器会在后台标签页里暂停动画帧。

98d0ad0a9566.en: Here is our event-loop simulator running an animation: every frame, a three millisecond requestAnimationFrame callback, then style, layout and paint. <bookmark mark='a'/> At forty milliseconds a click arrives, and its handler does a hundred and twenty milliseconds of work in one task. <bookmark mark='b'/> A task runs to completion, and rendering cannot happen in the middle of one. So after frames sixteen point seven milliseconds apart comes a gap of a hundred and twenty-six point seven: seven frames dropped, and the animation visibly stutters. That stutter is jank. <bookmark mark='c'/> Now split the same work into chunks of eight milliseconds, each scheduling the next with setTimeout of zero. Between chunks the loop gets a chance to render. <bookmark mark='d'/> No frame is dropped, though some arrive a few milliseconds late. <bookmark mark='e'/> The price is throughput: the work finishes at a hundred and ninety-six milliseconds instead of a hundred and sixty. <bookmark mark='f'/> Browsers flag any task over fifty milliseconds as a long task, and a click during one waits too.
98d0ad0a9566.zh: 这是我们的事件循环模拟器在运行一段动画：每一帧，先是一个3毫秒的 requestAnimationFrame 回调，然后是样式、布局和绘制。<bookmark mark='a'/>在第40毫秒，来了一次点击，它的处理程序在一个任务里做了120毫秒的工作。<bookmark mark='b'/>任务会一直运行到完成，渲染不能在任务中间发生。所以在一串间隔16.7毫秒的帧之后，出现了一个126.7毫秒的空档：丢了7帧，动画明显卡了一下。这种卡顿就叫 jank。<bookmark mark='c'/>现在把同样的工作拆成每块8毫秒，每一块用延迟为零的 setTimeout 来安排下一块。在两块之间，循环就有机会进行渲染。<bookmark mark='d'/>没有一帧被丢掉，尽管有些帧晚到了几毫秒。<bookmark mark='e'/>代价是吞吐量：工作在第196毫秒才完成，而不是第160毫秒。<bookmark mark='f'/>浏览器把任何超过50毫秒的任务标记为长任务，在长任务期间的一次点击也得等着。

b81e7d455e6c.en: A web page's JavaScript runs on one thread, driven by a loop the HTML standard writes out step by step. <bookmark mark='a'/> Take one task from a task queue: a timer, a click, a network reply. Run it to completion; nothing interrupts it. <bookmark mark='b'/> Then drain the microtask queue, the reactions of promises, completely, including any microtasks queued while draining. <bookmark mark='c'/> Then, if a frame is due, run the rendering steps: animation frame callbacks, style, layout and paint. <bookmark mark='d'/> And go round again. Everything about ordering on the web follows from these four steps.
b81e7d455e6c.zh: 网页的 JavaScript 在一个线程上运行，由一个循环驱动，HTML 标准一步一步地写出了这个循环。<bookmark mark='a'/>从一个任务队列里取出一个任务：一个定时器、一次点击、一个网络回复。把它运行到完成；没有什么能打断它。<bookmark mark='b'/>然后清空微任务队列，也就是 promise 的反应回调，要彻底清空，包括清空过程中新排进来的微任务。<bookmark mark='c'/>然后，如果该出一帧了，就运行渲染步骤：动画帧回调、样式、布局和绘制。<bookmark mark='d'/>然后再转一圈。Web 上关于次序的一切，都由这四步推出。

717e007c6408.en: Watch the loop run four lines. <bookmark mark='a'/> The script itself is the first task, and goes on the call stack. It logs A. <bookmark mark='b'/> setTimeout, even with a delay of zero, puts a callback in the task queue, to run in some later task. <bookmark mark='c'/> A promise's then puts its callback in the microtask queue. <bookmark mark='d'/> The script logs D, and finishes; the stack is empty. <bookmark mark='e'/> Before any other task, the microtasks drain: C. <bookmark mark='f'/> Only then does the loop take the next task, and B is logged last. A, D, C, B: our interpreter computes this order from the processing model, and every browser agrees.
717e007c6408.zh: 看这个循环运行四行代码。<bookmark mark='a'/>脚本本身是第一个任务，它被放上调用栈。它输出 A。<bookmark mark='b'/>setTimeout，即使延迟为零，也是把一个回调放进任务队列，要在之后的某个任务里运行。<bookmark mark='c'/>promise 的 then 把它的回调放进微任务队列。<bookmark mark='d'/>脚本输出 D，然后结束；栈空了。<bookmark mark='e'/>在任何其他任务之前，微任务先被清空：C。<bookmark mark='f'/>直到这时，循环才取下一个任务，B 最后输出。A、D、C、B：我们的解释器根据处理模型算出了这个次序，而每个浏览器都同意。

e4f1e1cffe62.en: The same four steps settle harder cases, and our interpreter computes each one. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here two timers and a promise whose reaction queues another. The synchronous log comes first, then both promise reactions, because a microtask queued while draining still runs in the same drain. Then the first timer, whose own microtask runs before the second timer. <bookmark mark='b'/> An async function runs synchronously until its first await. The rest of it becomes a microtask, queued before the promise below, so f resumes before then. <bookmark mark='c'/> Finally a timer against an animation frame. In our model the next frame is sixteen point seven milliseconds away, so the timer runs first; in a real browser those two can come in either order, and code should never depend on it.
e4f1e1cffe62.zh: 同样的四步也能解决更难的情形，我们的解释器把每一个都算了出来。<bookmark mark='a'/>这里有两个定时器，还有一个 promise，它的反应回调又排进了另一个。同步的输出先出现，然后是两个 promise 反应，因为清空过程中排进来的微任务，仍然在同一次清空里运行。然后是第一个定时器，它自己的微任务在第二个定时器之前运行。<bookmark mark='b'/>async 函数会同步地运行，直到它的第一个 await。它的其余部分变成一个微任务，排在下面那个 promise 之前，所以 f 在 then 之前恢复。<bookmark mark='c'/>最后，一个定时器对上一个动画帧。在我们的模型里，下一帧还有16.7毫秒，所以定时器先运行；在真实的浏览器里，这两者可能以任意次序出现，代码永远不应该依赖它。

55942186701f.en: Run to completion is a strong guarantee. <bookmark mark='a'/> No two pieces of script ever run at once, so the JavaScript heap cannot have the data races of Part 33: no lock is ever needed. Promises and async functions are concurrency without threads, continuations the loop resumes later. <bookmark mark='b'/> But every await ends a piece. Two quick clicks each ask for the stock, each hear that one item is left, and each places an order: a logical race, with no threads at all. <bookmark mark='c'/> And the guarantee cuts the other way too. A piece that never ends blocks everything behind it, rendering and input included, which is the frozen page of the last chapter.
55942186701f.zh: 运行到完成是一个很强的保证。<bookmark mark='a'/>永远不会有两段脚本同时运行，所以 JavaScript 的堆不可能出现第33部分的数据竞争：从来不需要锁。promise 和 async 函数是没有线程的并发，是循环稍后再恢复的续延。<bookmark mark='b'/>但是每一个 await 都会结束一段。快速点击两次，每次都去查询库存，每次都得知还剩一件，每次都下了一个订单：这是一个逻辑上的竞争，而根本没有线程。<bookmark mark='c'/>这个保证也有反面。一段永不结束的代码会阻塞它后面的一切，包括渲染和输入，这就是上一章那个冻住的页面。

9f223b5065d7.en: For work that really is long, a page can use more than one core. <bookmark mark='a'/> A Web Worker is a second thread with its own event loop and its own heap, and no access to the page. <bookmark mark='b'/> The two share nothing; they talk by posting messages, which arrive as tasks. The main thread sends the text, the worker counts it, and the counts come back, while the animation keeps its frames. <bookmark mark='c'/> A message is copied, or its buffer is transferred, leaving the sender with nothing. Shared memory with atomic operations exists too, only for pages isolated from other origins, and it brings the data races back.
9f223b5065d7.zh: 对于真正很长的工作，页面可以使用不止一个核心。<bookmark mark='a'/>Web Worker 是第二个线程，有它自己的事件循环和自己的堆，并且不能访问页面。<bookmark mark='b'/>两者什么都不共享；它们通过发送消息来交谈，消息以任务的形式到达。主线程发送文本，worker 统计词数，计数再传回来，而动画一直保持着它的帧。<bookmark mark='c'/>消息会被复制，或者它的缓冲区被转移，发送方手里就什么都不剩了。也有带原子操作的共享内存，但只给那些与其他源（origin）隔离的页面使用，而它又把数据竞争带了回来。

ee6fba6da4f9.en: A page arrives with its JavaScript as text, often far more than this visit will run. <bookmark mark='a'/> So the engine pre-parses each function body: a quick scan that checks the syntax and notes which outer variables the function uses, for closures, but builds no tree. <bookmark mark='b'/> When init is called, it is parsed in full and compiled, and so is render when init calls it. The checkout and refund handlers stay as text until someone clicks.
ee6fba6da4f9.zh: 一个页面带着它的 JavaScript 文本到来，往往远远超过这次访问会运行的量。<bookmark mark='a'/>所以引擎会预解析每个函数体：一次快速扫描，检查语法，并记下函数用到了哪些外层变量，以便处理闭包，但不建树。<bookmark mark='b'/>当 init 被调用时，它被完整地解析并编译；init 调用 render 时，render 也一样。结账和退款的处理程序则一直保持为文本，直到有人点击。

591ee7db184b.en: Then comes the pipeline Part 15 measured. <bookmark mark='a'/> Bytecode runs at once in an interpreter, which records what it sees: the types reaching each operation, the shapes reaching each property access. <bookmark mark='b'/> Hot functions move up, to a baseline compiler and then to an optimizing one, which specialises the code using that feedback, with a way back if its guesses fail. <bookmark mark='c'/> V8's tiers are Ignition, Sparkplug, Maglev and TurboFan; Firefox and Safari climb a similar ladder.
591ee7db184b.zh: 接下来是第15部分测量过的那条流水线。<bookmark mark='a'/>字节码立刻在解释器里运行，解释器记下它看到的东西：到达每个运算的类型，到达每次属性访问的形状。<bookmark mark='b'/>热的函数向上走，先到基线编译器，再到优化编译器，后者利用这些反馈把代码特化，如果它的猜测失败，还有一条退回去的路。<bookmark mark='c'/>V8 的各层是 Ignition、Sparkplug、Maglev 和 TurboFan；Firefox 和 Safari 也在爬一架类似的梯子。

f12a2b2a758e.en: How can a property be found quickly, when any object can gain properties at any time? <bookmark mark='a'/> Every object points to a hidden class, a shape: a table of which property lives in which slot. Adding a property follows a shared transition to a new shape. <bookmark mark='b'/> a gains x, then y. b does the same, and lands on the very same shape. <bookmark mark='c'/> c adds y first, and ends on a different one. <bookmark mark='d'/> Part 15 asked V8 itself, and it agrees: same order, same shape.
f12a2b2a758e.zh: 既然任何对象随时都可能增加属性，怎样才能快速找到一个属性呢？<bookmark mark='a'/>每个对象都指向一个隐藏类，也就是一个形状：一张表，记着哪个属性住在哪个槽里。增加一个属性，就沿着一条共享的转换走到一个新形状。<bookmark mark='b'/>a 先得到 x，再得到 y。b 也一样，落在完全相同的形状上。<bookmark mark='c'/>c 先加 y，最后落在另一个形状上。<bookmark mark='d'/>第15部分直接问过 V8，它也同意：次序相同，形状就相同。

70c10fc1325c.en: A shape lets the engine skip the table. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each access in the code, like p dot x here, keeps a small cache: the shapes it has seen, and where x was. <bookmark mark='b'/> We summed p dot x over ten thousand objects. Built one way, the site is monomorphic: one shape check per access. <bookmark mark='c'/> With two or four property orders it is polymorphic, trying up to four cached shapes in turn, two and a half checks per access. <bookmark mark='d'/> With eight, the cache overflows and the site goes megamorphic: a dictionary lookup on every one of the ten thousand accesses.
70c10fc1325c.zh: 有了形状，引擎就可以跳过查表。<bookmark mark='a'/>代码里的每一处访问，比如这里的 p.x，都保留一个小缓存：它见过的形状，以及 x 在哪里。<bookmark mark='b'/>我们在一万个对象上对 p.x 求和。如果它们都用同一种方式构建，这个访问点就是单态的：每次访问一次形状检查。<bookmark mark='c'/>如果有两种或四种属性次序，它就是多态的，依次尝试最多四个缓存的形状，每次访问2.5次检查。<bookmark mark='d'/>有八种时，缓存溢出，访问点变成超多态：一万次访问，每一次都要查字典。

dc994ce4bdfa.en: The optimizer also bets on types. <bookmark mark='a'/> add is called three times with small integers, so it is compiled as one machine addition, guarded by checks that both arguments really are small integers. <bookmark mark='b'/> Call five passes a string. The guard fails, and the engine deoptimizes, rebuilding the interpreter's frame and carrying on there. <bookmark mark='c'/> At call eight, add is compiled again, for integers or strings. <bookmark mark='d'/> Call nine overflows a small integer: another deoptimization, and at call twelve a version wide enough for all three. Feedback only widens, so a function settles.
dc994ce4bdfa.zh: 优化器还会对类型下注。<bookmark mark='a'/>add 被用小整数调用了三次，所以它被编译成一条机器加法，由检查守护着，确认两个参数真的都是小整数。<bookmark mark='b'/>第5次调用传入了一个字符串。守卫失败，引擎去优化：重建解释器的栈帧，并在那里接着运行。<bookmark mark='c'/>在第8次调用时，add 被重新编译，适用于整数或字符串。<bookmark mark='d'/>第9次调用让一个小整数溢出：又一次去优化，到第12次调用时，得到一个足够宽、能容纳这三种情况的版本。反馈只会变宽，所以函数最终会稳定下来。

3714ff2e9e40.en: And all those objects need collecting, with Part 15's collectors. <bookmark mark='a'/> New objects fill one half of a small young generation. <bookmark mark='b'/> Most die young: a scavenge copies the few survivors to the other half, so its cost is the living, not the garbage. <bookmark mark='c'/> Objects that survive twice move to the old generation. <bookmark mark='d'/> That is collected rarely, by mark and compact, with the marking done concurrently on helper threads, so JavaScript sees only short pauses, often scheduled in idle time between frames.
3714ff2e9e40.zh: 而所有这些对象都需要回收，用的是第15部分的回收器。<bookmark mark='a'/>新对象填满一个小小的新生代的一半。<bookmark mark='b'/>大多数对象死得早：一次清扫（scavenge）把少数幸存者复制到另一半，所以它的代价取决于活着的对象，而不是垃圾。<bookmark mark='c'/>存活过两次的对象被移到老年代。<bookmark mark='d'/>老年代很少回收，用的是标记—整理，标记在辅助线程上并发进行，所以 JavaScript 只会看到短暂的停顿，而且这些停顿常常被安排在帧与帧之间的空闲时间里。

402e07c2506e.en: Keeping every element in step with the program's state by hand is where interface bugs live. React, released in 2013, made a different promise. <bookmark mark='a'/> Describe the page as a function of the state; when the state changes, call it again, and get a new tree of plain objects, a virtual DOM. <bookmark mark='b'/> Compare it with the previous tree. Here one row's text differs. <bookmark mark='c'/> The result is a patch, one text edit, and only that touches the real DOM, where every change can mean style, layout and paint again.
402e07c2506e.zh: 手工让每个元素和程序的状态保持一致，正是界面 bug 的藏身之处。2013年发布的 React 做出了一个不同的承诺。<bookmark mark='a'/>把页面描述成状态的一个函数；状态变了，就再调用一次，得到一棵由普通对象组成的新树，也就是虚拟 DOM。<bookmark mark='b'/>把它和上一棵树比较。这里有一行的文字不同。<bookmark mark='c'/>结果是一个补丁，一次文字修改，只有它会碰到真实的 DOM，而在那里，每次改动都可能意味着重新做一遍样式、布局和绘制。

25a50d8e88ee.en: How should two trees be compared? <bookmark mark='a'/> Exactly, by tree edit distance: the fewest insertions, deletions and relabellings that turn one into the other. Zhang and Shasha's algorithm of 1989 is dynamic programming, as in Part 19, and general algorithms are still about cubic. <bookmark mark='b'/> On lists with one row changed, ours takes three hundred milliseconds at a hundred and twenty rows. <bookmark mark='c'/> React instead uses two rules: an element of a different type replaces its whole subtree, and children are matched by key or by position. That is linear, a third of a millisecond here, and it finds the same single edit.
25a50d8e88ee.zh: 两棵树应该怎么比较？<bookmark mark='a'/>精确的做法是树编辑距离：把一棵树变成另一棵所需的最少的插入、删除和重新标记。Zhang 和 Shasha 在1989年提出的算法是动态规划，就像第19部分那样，而通用算法至今仍大约是立方级的。<bookmark mark='b'/>在只改了一行的列表上，我们的实现在120行时要花300毫秒。<bookmark mark='c'/>React 则使用两条规则：类型不同的元素替换它的整棵子树，子元素按 key 或按位置匹配。这是线性的，这里只要三分之一毫秒，而且它找到的也是同一处修改。

8e90926df0b6.en: Lists need help. Here are four rows, and the user has ticked b. <bookmark mark='a'/> Add a row at the top. Matched by position, old rows pair with new rows in order: every row's text is rewritten, a new element appears at the end, and the tick, which lives in the element, now sits beside a. <bookmark mark='b'/> Give each row a key, a stable identity: one new element at the top, the others untouched, and the tick stays with b. <bookmark mark='c'/> On a hundred rows, a prepend touches three nodes by key and a hundred and three by position, and a hundred rows end up with another row's state.
8e90926df0b6.zh: 列表需要帮助。这里有四行，用户勾选了 b。<bookmark mark='a'/>在顶部加一行。按位置匹配时，旧行和新行按次序配对：每一行的文字都被重写，末尾出现一个新元素，而那个勾选，因为它存在元素里，现在跑到了 a 旁边。<bookmark mark='b'/>给每一行一个 key，一个稳定的身份：顶部一个新元素，其他的都不动，勾选也留在 b 那里。<bookmark mark='c'/>在100行上，在开头插入一行，按 key 只碰3个节点，按位置要碰103个，而且有100行最后带着别的行的状态。

5f677409b457.en: Keys say which rows survive, not how to move them. <bookmark mark='a'/> Swap the first and last of six rows. React walks the new order once, remembering the furthest old position placed so far. Row five comes first, so every later row, coming from further left, is moved: five moves. <bookmark mark='b'/> The fewest moves keep the longest run already in increasing order, one to four, and move only two. A longest increasing subsequence is a classic of Part 19, and Inferno and Vue 3 use it. <bookmark mark='c'/> On a hundred rows, reversing needs ninety-nine moves either way, but swapping two costs React's pass ninety-nine, against two: an honest weakness, rarely hit in practice.
5f677409b457.zh: key 说明的是哪些行留下，而不是怎样移动它们。<bookmark mark='a'/>把六行中的第一行和最后一行对调。React 按新的次序走一遍，记住到目前为止放置过的最靠后的旧位置。5号行排在最前面，所以之后的每一行，因为来自更左边，都要移动：移动5次。<bookmark mark='b'/>最少的移动是保留已经按递增次序排列的最长一段，也就是1到4号，只移动两行。最长递增子序列是第19部分的经典问题，Inferno 和 Vue 3 用的就是它。<bookmark mark='c'/>在100行上，反转无论用哪种方式都需要99次移动，但对调两行，React 的那一遍要花99次，而另一种只要2次：这是一个实实在在的弱点，不过实践中很少碰到。

2fbffbfd3b47.en: Another family of frameworks skips the virtual tree. <bookmark mark='a'/> State lives in signals: a first name, a last name, a count. Computed values read them, and the header reads those; each read records an edge, so the framework knows the graph. <bookmark mark='b'/> Set count to three: only the badge and the header re-run. <bookmark mark='c'/> Set the last name: full name, greeting and header re-run, and the badge does not. <bookmark mark='d'/> It is Part 41's build graph, recomputed on every write, with its early cutoff: a value that comes out unchanged stops the wave. SolidJS works this way, and now so do Svelte, Vue, Preact and Angular.
2fbffbfd3b47.zh: 另一类框架干脆跳过虚拟树。<bookmark mark='a'/>状态存在信号里：名、姓、一个计数。计算值读取它们，页眉又读取这些计算值；每次读取都记下一条边，所以框架知道这张图。<bookmark mark='b'/>把计数设为3：只有徽标和页眉重新运行。<bookmark mark='c'/>设置姓：全名、问候语和页眉重新运行，而徽标不会。<bookmark mark='d'/>这就是第41部分的构建图，每次写入都重新计算，并且带着它的提前截止：一个算出来没有变化的值，会让这一波停下。SolidJS 就是这样工作的，现在 Svelte、Vue、Preact 和 Angular 也是。

78b6a7db789b.en: Chapter nine. Caches, offline, and local-first software.
78b6a7db789b.zh: 第九章：缓存、离线与本地优先。

34f39c83299e.en: The fastest request is the one never sent. <bookmark mark='a'/> With its answer, a server can say how long the answer stays good: max age sixty, fresh for a minute. It also sends an ETag, a name for this version. <bookmark mark='b'/> Twenty seconds later, the browser uses its copy without asking anyone. <bookmark mark='c'/> After a minute the copy is stale, but not useless. The browser asks again, sending the ETag. Nothing has changed, so the server answers three hundred and four, not modified: headers only, a round trip but no body.
34f39c83299e.zh: 最快的请求，是从来没有发出的那一个。<bookmark mark='a'/>服务器在给出回答时，可以说明这个回答在多长时间内有效：max-age 60，一分钟内是新鲜的。它还会发送一个 ETag，也就是这个版本的名字。<bookmark mark='b'/>20秒之后，浏览器直接使用它的副本，不问任何人。<bookmark mark='c'/>一分钟之后，副本过期了，但并非没用。浏览器再问一次，带上 ETag。什么都没变，所以服务器回答304，Not Modified：只有头部，一次往返，但没有正文。

99501bc2288e.en: Here one file is requested nine times in seven minutes, and changes at three hundred seconds. <bookmark mark='a'/> With max age sixty: a miss, then two fresh hits, then revalidations answered with three hundred and four, until three hundred and twenty, when the ETag no longer matches and the new body comes back. Seven of the nine requests waited on the network. <bookmark mark='b'/> Add stale while revalidate, a hundred and twenty seconds: a stale copy is served at once, and checked in the background. Only the first request waits. <bookmark mark='c'/> The price: at three hundred and twenty, the user sees the old version, once.
99501bc2288e.zh: 这里一个文件在7分钟内被请求了9次，并在第300秒时发生了变化。<bookmark mark='a'/>用 max-age 60：先是一次未命中，然后两次新鲜命中，然后是用304回答的重新验证，直到第320秒，ETag 不再匹配，新的正文传了回来。9次请求里有7次在等网络。<bookmark mark='b'/>加上 stale-while-revalidate，120秒：过期的副本会被立刻送出，并在后台检查。只有第一次请求需要等待。<bookmark mark='c'/>代价是：在第320秒，用户会看到旧版本，一次。

9f2bc40d3763.en: Build tools avoid that bet altogether. <bookmark mark='a'/> The page is revalidated every time, but the scripts and styles it names carry a hash of their content in the file name: Part 41's content addressing. <bookmark mark='b'/> One name means one set of bytes, so those files are cached for a year and marked immutable, never checked. <bookmark mark='c'/> Change a line, and the build emits a new name. The page points at it, the browser fetches that one file, and the old copy is simply never used again.
9f2bc40d3763.zh: 构建工具干脆完全避开这场赌博。<bookmark mark='a'/>页面每次都要重新验证，但它引用的脚本和样式，文件名里带着其内容的哈希：这是第41部分的内容寻址。<bookmark mark='b'/>一个名字对应一组字节，所以这些文件被缓存一年，并标记为 immutable，从不检查。<bookmark mark='c'/>改一行代码，构建就会产出一个新名字。页面指向它，浏览器只取这一个文件，旧的副本就再也不会被用到了。

7e59a2c2add6.en: A service worker is a script the page installs between itself and the network. <bookmark mark='a'/> Every request the page makes, the worker sees first, and answers in ordinary JavaScript. <bookmark mark='b'/> Cache first: answer from the cache, and only on a miss go to the network, keeping a copy. That suits the app's own files, and lets it open with no connection at all. <bookmark mark='c'/> Network first: try the network, so the data is current, and when it is gone, fall back to the last copy. The page just keeps working.
7e59a2c2add6.zh: service worker 是页面安装在自己和网络之间的一段脚本。<bookmark mark='a'/>页面发出的每一个请求，都先经过这个 worker，它用普通的 JavaScript 来回答。<bookmark mark='b'/>缓存优先：从缓存回答，只有未命中时才去网络，并保留一份副本。这适合应用自己的文件，也让它在完全没有网络连接时也能打开。<bookmark mark='c'/>网络优先：先试网络，这样数据是最新的；网络断了，就退回到上一份副本。页面照样工作。

b9d35b1915c7.en: Those copies need somewhere to live. <bookmark mark='a'/> Cache storage holds responses, for the worker. IndexedDB is a small transactional database of objects with indexes, for the app's data. localStorage holds strings by key, synchronously, so a large read blocks the main thread. <bookmark mark='b'/> All of it belongs to one origin, and may be evicted under pressure, unless the page asks for persistent storage.
b9d35b1915c7.zh: 这些副本需要有个地方存放。<bookmark mark='a'/>缓存存储（Cache Storage）存放响应，供 worker 使用。IndexedDB 是一个小型的事务性对象数据库，带有索引，用来存放应用的数据。localStorage 按键存放字符串，而且是同步的，所以一次大的读取会阻塞主线程。<bookmark mark='b'/>所有这些都属于同一个源，并且在存储紧张时可能被清除，除非页面申请持久化存储。

76aa9584ed44.en: Push this further, and the server stops being the home of the data. <bookmark mark='a'/> In 2019 Martin Kleppmann and his co-authors, with the research lab Ink and Switch, called it local-first software: your data lives on your own devices, opens instantly, works offline, and servers only help the devices sync. <bookmark mark='b'/> A shopping list on two devices, both offline. The phone adds milk; the laptop adds bread and ticks off eggs. <bookmark mark='c'/> Reconnected, each sends the other its operations. <bookmark mark='d'/> A CRDT from Part 39 merges them: its merge is commutative, associative and idempotent, so both reach the same list, whatever order the messages arrive in. Automerge and Yjs are libraries built for exactly this.
76aa9584ed44.zh: 再往前推一步，服务器就不再是数据的家了。<bookmark mark='a'/>2019年，Martin Kleppmann 和他的合著者，与研究实验室 Ink and Switch 一起，把它称为本地优先软件：你的数据存在你自己的设备上，立刻打开，离线可用，服务器只是帮助设备同步。<bookmark mark='b'/>两台设备上的一张购物清单，两台都离线。手机加了牛奶；笔记本电脑加了面包，并勾掉了鸡蛋。<bookmark mark='c'/>重新连上之后，每台设备把自己的操作发给对方。<bookmark mark='d'/>第39部分的一种 CRDT 把它们合并：它的合并满足交换律、结合律和幂等律，所以无论消息以什么次序到达，两边都得到同一张清单。Automerge 和 Yjs 就是专门为此打造的库。

4526768042b4.en: Before a page can show anything, the browser must fetch and process everything that blocks rendering. Here is one page as a dependency graph, with illustrative timings. <bookmark mark='a'/> The HTML arrives first. It names a stylesheet and a synchronous script, and the stylesheet names a font, so each fetch waits for the file that mentions it. <bookmark mark='b'/> First paint waits for all of them, and the longest chain, HTML, CSS, font, is the critical path: three hundred and forty-five milliseconds. It is Part 41's build graph, with time on the edges. <bookmark mark='c'/> Now defer the script, and preload the font from the HTML. The font starts a hundred milliseconds earlier, and first paint moves to two hundred and forty-five. <bookmark mark='d'/> Browsers also rank their fetches, stylesheets and fonts high, images low, and a page can raise the one image that matters most.
4526768042b4.zh: 页面要显示任何东西之前，浏览器必须先取回并处理所有阻塞渲染的资源。这是一个页面的依赖图，时间是示意性的。<bookmark mark='a'/>HTML 最先到达。它指明了一个样式表和一个同步脚本，样式表又指明了一个字体，所以每次获取都要等提到它的那个文件。<bookmark mark='b'/>首次绘制要等所有这些都完成，而最长的那条链，HTML、CSS、字体，就是关键路径：345毫秒。这就是第41部分的构建图，只不过边上标的是时间。<bookmark mark='c'/>现在把脚本延迟执行（defer），并在 HTML 里预加载（preload）字体。字体提早100毫秒开始获取，首次绘制提前到245毫秒。<bookmark mark='d'/>浏览器还会给各次获取排优先级：样式表和字体高，图片低；页面也可以调高最要紧的那一张图片。

2a1753759c19.en: In 2020 Google named three Core Web Vitals, measured in real users' browsers. <bookmark mark='a'/> Largest Contentful Paint is the time until the biggest image or block of text is drawn; under two and a half seconds is good. <bookmark mark='b'/> Interaction to Next Paint is the delay from a tap or a key press to the next frame. In March 2024 it replaced First Input Delay, which timed only the wait before the first interaction began. Under two hundred milliseconds is good. <bookmark mark='c'/> Cumulative Layout Shift measures how much the page jumps while you read it; under a tenth is good. <bookmark mark='d'/> A page passes when three visits in four are good.
2a1753759c19.zh: 2020年，Google 提出了三项核心网页指标（Core Web Vitals），在真实用户的浏览器里测量。<bookmark mark='a'/>最大内容绘制（LCP）是最大的图片或文字块被画出来所需的时间；低于2.5秒算良好。<bookmark mark='b'/>交互到下一次绘制（INP）是从一次点按或按键到下一帧的延迟。2024年3月，它取代了首次输入延迟（FID），后者只计量第一次交互开始之前的等待。低于200毫秒算良好。<bookmark mark='c'/>累积布局偏移（CLS）衡量你阅读时页面跳动了多少；低于0.1算良好。<bookmark mark='d'/>四次访问中有三次良好，页面就算通过。

f99802d833d7.en: Layout shift has its own arithmetic. <bookmark mark='a'/> When a visible element moves, the shift scores its impact fraction, the share of the viewport it covers before and after, times its distance fraction, how far it moved. <bookmark mark='b'/> Here are five shifts in a page's first ten seconds. <bookmark mark='c'/> They are grouped into session windows, which close after a gap of a second, or after five seconds in all. Ours form three, worth point zero eight five, point one two five, and point zero zero two five. <bookmark mark='d'/> The score is the worst window, point one two five, which needs improvement. The usual culprits are images without a width and height, and late fonts and adverts.
f99802d833d7.zh: 布局偏移有它自己的算术。<bookmark mark='a'/>当一个可见元素移动时，这次偏移的得分是它的影响比例，也就是它在移动前后覆盖的视口份额，乘以它的距离比例，也就是它移动了多远。<bookmark mark='b'/>这是一个页面在最初10秒里的五次偏移。<bookmark mark='c'/>它们被分组成会话窗口，窗口在出现1秒的间隔之后关闭，或者总长满5秒时关闭。我们的偏移形成三个窗口，分别是0.085、0.125和0.0025。<bookmark mark='d'/>得分取最差的窗口，0.125，属于“需要改进”。常见的元凶是没有宽度和高度的图片，以及迟到的字体和广告。

12fbd975e456.en: Fewer bytes arrive sooner. <bookmark mark='a'/> We measured three of this series' own files. Gzip, which every browser accepts, shrinks the syllabus to 41 per cent of its size. Bzip2 and xz do better, but browsers do not accept them, and the web's newer codec, Brotli, is not installed here, so we have no figure for it. <bookmark mark='b'/> Images are usually most of the bytes. AVIF and WebP are smaller at the same quality; a source set lets a small screen fetch a small file; lazy loading waits until an image is near; and a width and height reserve its space.
12fbd975e456.zh: 字节越少，到得越快。<bookmark mark='a'/>我们测量了这个系列自己的三个文件。每个浏览器都接受的 Gzip，把教学大纲压缩到原来大小的百分之41。Bzip2 和 xz 压得更好，但浏览器不接受它们；而 Web 较新的编解码器 Brotli 这里没有安装，所以我们没有它的数据。<bookmark mark='b'/>图片通常占了字节的大头。AVIF 和 WebP 在同样画质下更小；源集（source set）让小屏幕获取小文件；懒加载等到图片快进入视野时才加载；而宽度和高度会为图片预留位置。

25bca5806912.en: Then the connection itself. <bookmark mark='a'/> HTTP one point one carries one request at a time per connection, so browsers opened about six connections to each host. HTTP/2, in 2015, multiplexes many streams over a single TCP connection, as interleaved frames. <bookmark mark='b'/> But TCP delivers bytes strictly in order, so when one packet is lost, every stream waits for its retransmission: head-of-line blocking, from Part 37. <bookmark mark='c'/> HTTP/3, standardised in 2022, runs over QUIC on UDP, which keeps order only within each stream. A loss now stalls only the stream it belongs to, and the handshake folds in TLS, from Part 30, saving a round trip.
25bca5806912.zh: 然后是连接本身。<bookmark mark='a'/>HTTP 1.1 每个连接一次只承载一个请求，所以浏览器会对每个主机开大约六个连接。2015年的 HTTP/2 在单个 TCP 连接上复用许多条流，以交错的帧来传输。<bookmark mark='b'/>但 TCP 严格按顺序交付字节，所以一旦丢了一个包，每条流都要等它重传：这就是第37部分讲过的队头阻塞。<bookmark mark='c'/>2022年标准化的 HTTP/3 运行在基于 UDP 的 QUIC 之上，QUIC 只在每条流内部保持顺序。现在一次丢包只会让它所属的那条流停顿；而且握手把第30部分的 TLS 合并了进来，省掉一次往返。

bde66897d3f0.en: A browser runs code from every site you visit, so its first rule is about who may read what. <bookmark mark='a'/> An origin is three things: the scheme, the host and the port. The path does not count. <bookmark mark='b'/> Two pages share an origin only if all three match. Change https to http, add a port, or move to a subdomain, and they are strangers. <bookmark mark='c'/> A page may embed images, scripts and frames from anywhere, and send requests anywhere, but its scripts may read only what their own origin serves.
bde66897d3f0.zh: 浏览器运行着你访问的每个网站的代码，所以它的第一条规则，是关于谁可以读什么。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个源（origin）由三样东西组成：协议、主机和端口。路径不算在内。<bookmark mark='b'/>两个页面只有在三者都相同时才同源。把 https 改成 http，加一个端口，或者换到一个子域名，它们就是陌生人。<bookmark mark='c'/>页面可以从任何地方嵌入图片、脚本和框架，也可以向任何地方发送请求，但它的脚本只能读取它自己的源所提供的内容。

23eb063bec88.en: Reading across origins needs the server to opt in. <bookmark mark='a'/> The browser sends the request, but when the response returns, it looks for a header naming the page's origin. Without one, the script never sees it. <bookmark mark='b'/> Here are six requests from a shop's page, decided by our model of the rules. A plain GET is always sent, but readable only if the server allows us. <bookmark mark='c'/> A PUT or a custom header could do things an old server never expected, so the browser first asks permission with a preflight, and if refused, never sends the request. And a request with cookies must be allowed by name, not by a wildcard.
23eb063bec88.zh: 跨源读取需要服务器主动同意。<bookmark mark='a'/>浏览器会发出请求，但响应回来时，它会寻找一个写明该页面的源的头部。没有这个头部，脚本就永远看不到响应。<bookmark mark='b'/>这是一个商店页面发出的六个请求，由我们对这些规则建立的模型来裁决。普通的 GET 总会被发出，但只有服务器允许我们，才能读取。<bookmark mark='c'/>PUT 或者自定义头部可能做出旧服务器从未预料到的事情，所以浏览器先用一次预检请求征求许可；如果被拒绝，就根本不发送这个请求。而带 cookie 的请求必须按名字明确允许，不能用通配符。

dbc31128a759.en: The commonest attack breaks no rule: it gets the attacker's code served from your origin. <bookmark mark='a'/> A page greets users by pasting their name into its HTML, and someone picks a name that is itself HTML. <bookmark mark='b'/> Our parser from Chapter 2 builds the tree, and beside the greeting is an image with an error handler. The image fails to load, the handler runs with the page's authority, and the cookies go wherever it sends them. This is cross-site scripting. <bookmark mark='c'/> Escape the name, so the angle brackets become character references, and the same parser makes one text node: shown, not run.
dbc31128a759.zh: 最常见的攻击不违反任何规则：它让攻击者的代码从你的源提供出来。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个页面把用户的名字粘贴进 HTML 来问候用户，而有人取了一个本身就是 HTML 的名字。<bookmark mark='b'/>我们第2章的解析器构建出树，问候语旁边多了一张带错误处理程序的图片。图片加载失败，处理程序以页面的权限运行，cookie 就被送到它想送的任何地方。这就是跨站脚本攻击（XSS）。<bookmark mark='c'/>把名字转义，让尖括号变成字符引用，同一个解析器就只生成一个文本节点：显示出来，而不是运行。

7fce480c7f77.en: A Content Security Policy is the second line of defence. <bookmark mark='a'/> The server lists where scripts may come from, here only its own origin, <bookmark mark='b'/> and the browser refuses everything else: inline handlers like our injected one, and scripts from other origins. <bookmark mark='c'/> And marking the session cookie HttpOnly hides it from scripts altogether.
7fce480c7f77.zh: 内容安全策略（Content Security Policy）是第二道防线。<bookmark mark='a'/>服务器列出脚本可以来自哪里，这里只有它自己的源，<bookmark mark='b'/>浏览器则拒绝其他一切：像我们注入的那种内联处理程序，以及来自其他源的脚本。<bookmark mark='c'/>再把会话 cookie 标记为 HttpOnly，就能把它对脚本完全隐藏起来。

040f93ecd281.en: Cookies bring the opposite danger. <bookmark mark='a'/> The browser attaches a site's cookies to every request to that site, whoever starts it, so another site's page can submit a hidden form to your bank, which sees you signed in: cross-site request forgery. <bookmark mark='b'/> The SameSite attribute stops it. A Lax cookie crosses sites only when you follow a link at the top level; a Strict cookie never does. <bookmark mark='c'/> Since 2020, Chrome treats a cookie without the attribute as Lax.
040f93ecd281.zh: cookie 带来的是相反的危险。<bookmark mark='a'/>浏览器会把一个网站的 cookie 附加到发往该网站的每个请求上，不管请求是谁发起的；所以另一个网站的页面可以向你的银行提交一个隐藏表单，而银行看到的是你已经登录：这就是跨站请求伪造（CSRF）。<bookmark mark='b'/>SameSite 属性可以阻止它。Lax cookie 只有在你于顶层点击链接时才会跨站；Strict cookie 从不跨站。<bookmark mark='c'/>从2020年起，Chrome 把没有这个属性的 cookie 当作 Lax。

4bd180ff23f7.en: <bookmark mark='a'/> Browsers split themselves into processes: a privileged browser process, and sandboxed renderers that run pages and cannot touch files or the network directly. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 2018, Spectre showed that speculative execution, from Part 8, lets a script read memory in its own process through cache timing, so an attacker's frame could read the page beside it. <bookmark mark='c'/> The answer was site isolation: each site gets its own renderer process, kept apart by the hardware's memory protection rather than the engine's checks.
4bd180ff23f7.zh: <bookmark mark='a'/>浏览器把自己拆成多个进程：一个有特权的浏览器进程，以及运行页面的沙箱化渲染进程，后者不能直接接触文件或网络。<bookmark mark='b'/>2018年，Spectre 表明，第8部分讲过的推测执行能让脚本通过缓存计时，读取它自己进程里的内存，所以攻击者的框架可以读取旁边的页面。<bookmark mark='c'/>解决办法是站点隔离：每个站点都有自己的渲染进程，靠硬件的内存保护而不是引擎的检查把它们隔开。

ecfa91fbb98e.en: WebAssembly, in every major browser since 2017, brings compiled languages into the same sandbox. <bookmark mark='a'/> C, C++ or Rust compile to a compact, typed bytecode. The browser validates it before it runs, then compiles it to machine code, as Part 15's JIT did. <bookmark mark='b'/> A module can address only its own linear memory, and an access outside it traps.
ecfa91fbb98e.zh: WebAssembly 自2017年起进入所有主流浏览器，它把编译型语言带进了同一个沙箱。<bookmark mark='a'/>C、C++ 或 Rust 被编译成紧凑的、带类型的字节码。浏览器在运行前先验证它，然后像第15部分的 JIT 那样，把它编译成机器码。<bookmark mark='b'/>一个模块只能访问它自己的线性内存，越界的访问会触发陷阱。

85adcf55a93c.zh: 第十二章：无障碍与移动端。

e23bf8ff4d80.en: A screen reader does not see pixels. <bookmark mark='a'/> From the DOM the browser derives a second tree, the accessibility tree, and hands it to the operating system: for everything a person can perceive or operate, a role, a name and a state. <bookmark mark='b'/> A button element becomes a button named Buy; a checkbox is named by its label, and is checked; an image is named by its alt text. <bookmark mark='c'/> But a div with a click handler is just generic text: nothing to press, and the keyboard cannot reach it.
e23bf8ff4d80.zh: 屏幕阅读器看不到像素。<bookmark mark='a'/>浏览器从 DOM 推导出第二棵树，也就是无障碍树，并把它交给操作系统：对于人能感知或操作的每样东西，给出一个角色、一个名称和一个状态。<bookmark mark='b'/>一个 button 元素成为名为 Buy 的按钮；复选框以它的标签命名，并且处于选中状态；图片以它的 alt 文本命名。<bookmark mark='c'/>但带点击处理程序的 div 只是通用的文本：没有可按的东西，键盘也到不了它。

6f0f286c7eac.en: Many people use only a keyboard. <bookmark mark='a'/> Tab moves the focus in the order of the DOM, not the order on screen, so a layout rearranged by CSS sends the focus jumping. <bookmark mark='b'/> ARIA attributes can repair the accessibility tree with a role, a name or a state, but the keys are then yours to handle. The first rule of ARIA is to prefer the native element, which brings it all for free.
6f0f286c7eac.zh: 许多人只用键盘。<bookmark mark='a'/>Tab 键按 DOM 的顺序移动焦点，而不是按屏幕上的顺序，所以被 CSS 重新排列过的布局会让焦点四处乱跳。<bookmark mark='b'/>ARIA 属性可以用角色、名称或状态修补无障碍树，但这样一来，按键就得你自己处理了。ARIA 的第一条规则是优先使用原生元素，它免费带来这一切。

7d1814b9d3e9.en: Text must also be readable, and the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines, WCAG, make readable a number. <bookmark mark='a'/> sRGB values are gamma-encoded, so first undo it: a short straight piece near black, then a power of two point four. <bookmark mark='b'/> Weight the linear channels by how bright each primary looks, mostly green, to get the relative luminance. <bookmark mark='c'/> The contrast ratio is the lighter luminance plus five hundredths, over the darker plus five hundredths: one for equal colours, twenty-one for black on white. <bookmark mark='d'/> Our blue, on our background: point three seven against point zero zero eight six, a ratio of seven point one.
7d1814b9d3e9.zh: 文字还必须易读，而 Web 内容无障碍指南（WCAG）把“易读”变成了一个数。<bookmark mark='a'/>sRGB 值是经过伽马编码的，所以先要撤销编码：靠近黑色处是一小段直线，其余部分是2.4次幂。<bookmark mark='b'/>按每种原色看起来有多亮，给线性通道加权，主要是绿色，就得到相对亮度。<bookmark mark='c'/>对比度是较亮的亮度加0.05，除以较暗的亮度加0.05：颜色相同时是1，白底黑字是21。<bookmark mark='d'/>我们的蓝色在我们的背景上：0.37对0.0086，对比度是7.1。

a7e9789144c6.en: Normal text needs four and a half to one for level AA, large text three, and level AAA seven. <bookmark mark='a'/> On white, the lightest grey that passes AA is hex seven six seven six seven six. <bookmark mark='b'/> On our background, every colour of this series' palette but one passes AA, and four pass AAA. <bookmark mark='c'/> The darkest grey fails, at one point eight four. It should carry lines, not words, yet our own timeline strip prints its years in it: a fault this check has just found.
a7e9789144c6.zh: 正文文字在 AA 级需要4.5比1，大号文字需要3比1，AAA 级需要7比1。<bookmark mark='a'/>在白色上，能通过 AA 的最浅灰色是十六进制 767676。<bookmark mark='b'/>在我们的背景上，这个系列调色板里除了一种颜色之外都能通过 AA，有四种能通过 AAA。<bookmark mark='c'/>最深的那种灰色不及格，只有1.84。它应该用来画线条，而不是写字，可我们自己的时间轴条却用它印年份：这正是这次检查刚刚发现的一个缺陷。

1eda224dc257.en: On a phone, the radio's cost depends on its state, not just on the bytes. <bookmark mark='a'/> In the LTE model measured by Huang and colleagues in 2012, waking the radio takes about a quarter of a second, and after a transfer it lingers in a high-power tail of about eleven and a half seconds. <bookmark mark='b'/> Ten small requests twenty seconds apart pay that tail ten times: about a hundred and thirty joules in our model. <bookmark mark='c'/> Sent together, they pay it once: about sixteen and a half joules, nearly eight times less. So phones batch background work.
1eda224dc257.zh: 在手机上，无线电模块的开销取决于它的状态，而不只是字节数。<bookmark mark='a'/>在 Huang 和同事2012年测量的 LTE 模型里，唤醒无线电大约要四分之一秒，一次传输之后，它还会在一段高功耗的尾巴里停留大约11.5秒。<bookmark mark='b'/>十个小请求，每隔20秒发一个，就要付这段尾巴十次：在我们的模型里大约130焦耳。<bookmark mark='c'/>把它们一起发出，只付一次：大约16.5焦耳，少了将近八倍。所以手机会把后台工作攒起来批量处理。

67d391672e7a.en: Native apps share the browser's problem. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each has one UI thread, which handles input and must deliver a frame every sixteen point seven milliseconds at sixty hertz, as in Chapter 5. A file read on that thread misses a frame. <bookmark mark='b'/> So disk and network work move to other threads, and Android offers to close an app that ignores input for five seconds.
67d391672e7a.zh: 原生应用也有浏览器的这个问题。<bookmark mark='a'/>每个应用都有一个 UI 线程，它处理输入，并且必须在60赫兹下每16.7毫秒交付一帧，就像第5章讲的那样。在这个线程上读一次文件，就会错过一帧。<bookmark mark='b'/>所以磁盘和网络工作都移到其他线程去做；如果一个应用5秒不响应输入，Android 会提出关闭它。

b49cc621f41b.en: <bookmark mark='a'/> Each platform has its own toolkit: UIKit and SwiftUI on iOS, Views and Jetpack Compose on Android, the newer ones declarative, like Chapter 8's frameworks. <bookmark mark='b'/> Cross-platform frameworks share one codebase. React Native, from 2015, drives the platform's own widgets from JavaScript; <bookmark mark='c'/> Flutter draws every pixel itself. The trade is one codebase against looking and behaving exactly like each platform.
b49cc621f41b.zh: <bookmark mark='a'/>每个平台都有自己的工具包：iOS 上是 UIKit 和 SwiftUI，Android 上是 Views 和 Jetpack Compose，较新的那些是声明式的，就像第8章的框架。<bookmark mark='b'/>跨平台框架共享一份代码库。2015年推出的 React Native 用 JavaScript 驱动平台自己的控件；<bookmark mark='c'/>Flutter 则自己绘制每一个像素。取舍在于：一份代码库，还是外观和行为与每个平台完全一致。

2f54db6c4dd7.zh: 第十三章：我们的玩具浏览器。

9c16cfd3cb94.en: Here are the stages run on the README, one at a time. <bookmark mark='a'/> The source is Markdown, a few dozen lines of it. A converter of about fifty lines turns headings, lists, emphasis and code into HTML. <bookmark mark='b'/> The tokenizer of chapter two reads that HTML a character at a time, producing 236 tokens, and the tree builder turns them into a document tree: headings, paragraphs, lists, and the text inside them. <bookmark mark='c'/> Then the cascade. A user-agent stylesheet of seven rules gives headings their size and colour, paragraphs and list items their margins, and code its own colour, and inheritance carries the font size from a list item into the bold text inside it.
9c16cfd3cb94.zh: 这是在 README 上运行的各个阶段，一次一个。<bookmark mark='a'/>源文件是 Markdown，有几十行。一个大约50行的转换器把标题、列表、强调和代码变成 HTML。<bookmark mark='b'/>第二章的词法分析器一次一个字符地读取这段 HTML，产生236个记号，树构建器再把它们变成一棵文档树：标题、段落、列表，以及其中的文字。<bookmark mark='c'/>然后是层叠。一个有七条规则的用户代理样式表，给标题设定字号和颜色，给段落和列表项设定外边距，给代码设定它自己的颜色；而继承把字号从列表项带进它里面的粗体文字。

412af1577758.en: Layout walks down the tree. <bookmark mark='a'/> Every heading, paragraph and list item becomes a block box, 23 of them, stacked down the page, each as tall as the lines inside it. <bookmark mark='b'/> Inside a block, inline layout places the words one at a time, measuring each in its font, and starts a new line when the next word would cross the right edge. That is the greedy line breaker of chapter four. <bookmark mark='c'/> Two details a real browser also has to get right. A word in Chinese falls back to a font that has those characters. <bookmark mark='d'/> And spaces come from the source: where the HTML has no space between a bold word and its colon, neither does the screen. Then the painter draws every word, and the page on the right is the result.
412af1577758.zh: 布局沿着树往下走。<bookmark mark='a'/>每个标题、段落和列表项都成为一个块盒，一共23个，在页面上自上而下堆叠，每个盒子的高度就是它里面各行的高度。<bookmark mark='b'/>在块内部，行内布局一次放一个词，用它的字体测量每个词，当下一个词会越过右边缘时就另起一行。这就是第四章的贪心断行算法。<bookmark mark='c'/>还有两个细节，真正的浏览器也必须做对。中文的词会回退到一个包含这些字符的字体。<bookmark mark='d'/>而空格来自源文件：HTML 里粗体词和它后面的冒号之间没有空格，屏幕上也就没有。然后绘制器画出每个词，右边的页面就是结果。

bb588a78a26b.en: How fast is it? We timed each stage on this machine, the median of five runs. <bookmark mark='a'/> Converting the Markdown, tokenizing and building the tree take a few milliseconds together. The cascade takes about 2, and layout about 22. <bookmark mark='b'/> Painting, including encoding the image file, takes about 122. <bookmark mark='c'/> One frame at sixty hertz is sixteen point seven milliseconds, and our browser needs about 149 for one page. <bookmark mark='d'/> Real engines are compiled code, they restyle and lay out only what changed, and they rasterize in tiles on the GPU. So a first load may take a while, but every frame after it fits the budget.
bb588a78a26b.zh: 它有多快？我们在这台机器上给每个阶段计时，取五次运行的中位数。<bookmark mark='a'/>转换 Markdown、词法分析和建树，加起来只要几毫秒。层叠大约要2毫秒，布局大约22毫秒。<bookmark mark='b'/>绘制，包括编码图像文件，大约要122毫秒。<bookmark mark='c'/>60赫兹下的一帧是16.7毫秒，而我们的浏览器画一页大约要149毫秒。<bookmark mark='d'/>真正的引擎是编译过的代码，它们只对变化的部分重新计算样式和布局，并在 GPU 上分块光栅化。所以首次加载可能要花点时间，但之后的每一帧都在预算之内。

52cfa4621433.en: And what it leaves out. <bookmark mark='a'/> Our parser has a dozen states and one repair rule for misnested formatting; the standard's tokenizer has about eighty states, and the tree builder has insertion modes for tables, forms and scripts. Our CSS knows tags, classes, identifiers and descendants. Our layout knows blocks and greedy lines, not floats, tables, flexbox, grid, bidirectional text or hyphenation. And it runs no scripts, fetches nothing and needs no security, because it trusts its only input. <bookmark mark='b'/> A real engine is tens of millions of lines. If you want to go further, the open book Web Browser Engineering, by Pavel Panchekha and Chris Harrelson, builds a much fuller browser in a few thousand lines of Python.
52cfa4621433.zh: 还有它省略了什么。<bookmark mark='a'/>我们的解析器有十来个状态，以及一条修复错误嵌套格式的规则；标准的词法分析器大约有80个状态，树构建器还有针对表格、表单和脚本的插入模式。我们的 CSS 认识标签、类、ID 和后代选择器。我们的布局认识块和贪心断行，不认识浮动、表格、flexbox、grid、双向文本或断字。而且它不运行脚本，不获取任何东西，也不需要任何安全措施，因为它信任它唯一的输入。<bookmark mark='b'/>一个真正的引擎有几千万行代码。如果你想更进一步，Pavel Panchekha 和 Chris Harrelson 写的开放图书《Web Browser Engineering》用几千行 Python 构建了一个完整得多的浏览器。

fc77673009f4.en: Chapter fourteen, the frontier. Can a browser be fast, correct and safe, all at once?
fc77673009f4.zh: 第十四章，前沿。浏览器能不能同时做到快速、正确和安全？

9393c1842790.en: Is layout cheap? In normal flow, one pass down the tree and one back up is enough, so the cost is linear in the size of the page. <bookmark mark='a'/> Modern layout asks harder questions. A flex container inside a flex container first asks each child for its preferred size, and then lays it out again at the size it actually gets. Two layouts of the child per level. <bookmark mark='b'/> Nest that twenty levels deep and, without care, the innermost box is laid out about two million times: 2,097,151, counted by our model. <bookmark mark='c'/> With a cache keyed by the box and the width it was offered, it is laid out 41 times. Real engines keep exactly such caches, and pathological pages that defeat them still turn up. Whether the full CSS layout model always admits a linear algorithm, and how to make relayout cost proportional to the change, are open.
9393c1842790.zh: 布局便宜吗？在常规流里，沿树向下一遍、再向上一遍就够了，所以代价与页面大小成线性关系。<bookmark mark='a'/>现代布局提出了更难的问题。flex 容器里的 flex 容器，先要问每个子元素它的首选尺寸，然后再按它实际得到的尺寸重新布局一次。每一层，子元素要布局两次。<bookmark mark='b'/>嵌套20层，如果不加小心，最里面的盒子大约要布局200万次：我们的模型数出来是2097151次。<bookmark mark='c'/>用一个以盒子和提供给它的宽度为键的缓存，它只布局41次。真正的引擎恰好保留着这样的缓存，而能击败这些缓存的病态页面仍然时有出现。完整的 CSS 布局模型是否总能有线性算法，以及如何让重新布局的代价与变化成正比，都还是悬而未决的问题。

439c821bd5c6.en: If layout is a constraint problem, a solver can reason about it. <bookmark mark='a'/> Cassius, by Pavel Panchekha and Emina Torlak in 2016, wrote the rules of CSS layout as logical formulas. <bookmark mark='b'/> Give a solver the formulas and a page, and it can prove that a property holds, such as no text ever overlapping, or produce a page where it fails. The same encoding can synthesize a stylesheet from a sketch, and its successor VizAssert checks accessibility and usability properties for every screen size at once. <bookmark mark='c'/> Another line of work treats layout as an attribute grammar, computed by tree traversals that can run in parallel; Leo Meyerovich and Rastislav Bodík did this in 2010, and Mozilla's Servo engine, whose parallel styling has shipped in Firefox since 2017, carried the idea into practice.
439c821bd5c6.zh: 如果布局是一个约束问题，求解器就可以对它进行推理。<bookmark mark='a'/>2016年，Pavel Panchekha 和 Emina Torlak 的 Cassius 把 CSS 布局的规则写成了逻辑公式。<bookmark mark='b'/>把这些公式和一个页面交给求解器，它就能证明某个性质成立，比如文字永远不会重叠，或者构造出一个让这个性质不成立的页面。同样的编码还可以根据草图合成样式表；它的后继者 VizAssert 能对所有屏幕尺寸一次性检查无障碍和可用性方面的性质。<bookmark mark='c'/>另一条研究路线把布局看作属性文法，通过可以并行运行的树遍历来计算；Leo Meyerovich 和 Rastislav Bodík 在2010年做了这件事，而 Mozilla 的 Servo 引擎把这个想法带进了实践，它的并行样式计算自2017年起就已在 Firefox 中发布。

2e4acb069f82.en: The JavaScript engine is where speed and safety collide. <bookmark mark='a'/> Its optimizing compiler makes assumptions from type feedback, and removes checks it believes are redundant. <bookmark mark='b'/> If one of those deductions is wrong, a bounds check disappears that was needed, and a script from any web page can read and write past the end of an array, and from there reach arbitrary memory in its process. Bugs of this shape, in the engines' compilers and type systems, have been among the most valuable browser exploits for a decade. <bookmark mark='c'/> What still stands between such a script and the computer is the sandbox around the renderer process. <bookmark mark='d'/> Defences grow in layers: V8 added a sandbox inside its own heap in 2024, and fuzzers generate millions of JavaScript programs to find such bugs first. <bookmark mark='e'/> The open goal is a JIT whose optimizations are proved correct, as CompCert's are for C, and still fast enough to ship.
2e4acb069f82.zh: JavaScript 引擎是速度与安全相撞的地方。<bookmark mark='a'/>它的优化编译器根据类型反馈做出假设，并删除它认为多余的检查。<bookmark mark='b'/>如果其中一个推断是错的，一个本来需要的边界检查就消失了，任何网页上的脚本都能越过数组末尾去读写，并由此触及它所在进程里的任意内存。这种形态的漏洞，出在引擎的编译器和类型系统里，十年来一直是最值钱的浏览器漏洞利用之一。<bookmark mark='c'/>在这样的脚本和计算机之间，仍然挡着的是渲染进程周围的沙箱。<bookmark mark='d'/>防御是一层层加上去的：V8 在2024年在它自己的堆里加了一个沙箱，而模糊测试工具生成数以百万计的 JavaScript 程序，抢先找到这类漏洞。<bookmark mark='e'/>悬而未决的目标是一个 JIT，它的优化被证明是正确的，就像 CompCert 对 C 所做的那样，同时又快到足以发布。

083ca1f77b9a.en: Security has its own formal frontier. The web's rules are scattered across hundreds of documents, and attacks live in the gaps between them. <bookmark mark='a'/> In 2010, Devdatta Akhawe, Adam Barth and colleagues wrote the web's actors and rules, browsers, servers, cookies, redirects and an attacker with a server of its own, as a model in the Alloy analyzer, and it found new attacks on defences that had been proposed. <bookmark mark='b'/> Featherweight Firefox, by Aaron Bohannon and Benjamin Pierce, modelled a browser's core. The Web Infrastructure Model of Daniel Fett, Ralf Küsters and Guido Schmitz has been used to find attacks on OAuth, the protocol behind signing in with another site's account, and to prove the repaired versions secure. <bookmark mark='c'/> And WebSpec, in 2023, checked browser rules with a solver and found new attacks on the integrity of cookies.
083ca1f77b9a.zh: 安全也有它自己的形式化前沿。Web 的规则散落在数百份文档里，而攻击就藏在它们之间的缝隙中。<bookmark mark='a'/>2010年，Devdatta Akhawe、Adam Barth 和同事把 Web 的参与者和规则，即浏览器、服务器、cookie、重定向，以及一个拥有自己服务器的攻击者，写成了 Alloy 分析器里的一个模型，它在已经提出的防御上发现了新的攻击。<bookmark mark='b'/>Aaron Bohannon 和 Benjamin Pierce 的 Featherweight Firefox 为浏览器的核心建立了模型。Daniel Fett、Ralf Küsters 和 Guido Schmitz 的 Web 基础设施模型（Web Infrastructure Model）被用来发现 OAuth 上的攻击，OAuth 就是“用另一个网站的账号登录”背后的协议；它还被用来证明修复后的版本是安全的。<bookmark mark='c'/>而2023年的 WebSpec 用求解器检查浏览器规则，发现了针对 cookie 完整性的新攻击。

2a08dff2850b.en: Open problems. <bookmark mark='a'/> Incremental layout: relayout whose cost is provably proportional to the size of a change, even with flexbox, grid and intrinsic sizes. <bookmark mark='b'/> Verified engines: a JavaScript compiler whose optimizations are proved correct, and fast enough to ship. <bookmark mark='c'/> Security proofs about the whole web: a model complete enough that a proof about it covers the browsers people use. <bookmark mark='d'/> And scheduling: splitting a page's work into tasks so that no input waits longer than a bound, deciding online as the work arrives. <bookmark mark='e'/> This part's research problem asks for a flex-layout algorithm with intrinsic sizing whose relayout cost is bounded by the size of the change, together with a matching lower bound.
2a08dff2850b.zh: 开放问题。<bookmark mark='a'/>增量布局：重新布局的代价可以被证明与变化的大小成正比，即使有 flexbox、grid 和固有尺寸。<bookmark mark='b'/>经过验证的引擎：一个优化被证明正确的 JavaScript 编译器，而且快到足以发布。<bookmark mark='c'/>关于整个 Web 的安全证明：一个足够完整的模型，使得关于它的证明能覆盖人们实际使用的浏览器。<bookmark mark='d'/>还有调度：把页面的工作拆分成任务，使得没有任何输入的等待超过某个上限，并且在工作到来时在线做出决定。<bookmark mark='e'/>这一部分的研究题要求一个带固有尺寸的 flex 布局算法，其重新布局代价以变化的大小为界，同时给出一个相匹配的下界。

e212f34ad2c7.en: What we built in this part. An HTML parser that turns every input into a tree, because the web's standard says what to do with every mistake. A cascade that orders rules by origin, by specificity as a triple compared lexicographically, and by order, and matches selectors from the right. Layout as a distribution of space, and line breaking as a shortest path, better than greedy on almost every paragraph of a novel. An event loop that runs a task, drains its microtasks and renders a frame, and a long task that drops seven frames. Hidden classes and inline caches, keyed lists and signals. And caches, origins and a contrast ratio derived from the physics of light. One idea runs through it: a browser does as little work as possible, as late as possible, inside a sixteen-millisecond frame.
e212f34ad2c7.zh: 我们在这一部分构建了什么。一个 HTML 解析器，把每一份输入都变成一棵树，因为 Web 的标准规定了遇到每一种错误该怎么办。一个层叠，按来源、按优先级（specificity，作为三元组按字典序比较）、再按顺序给规则排序，并从右往左匹配选择器。把布局看作空间的分配，把断行看作最短路径，在一部小说几乎每一个段落上都胜过贪心算法。一个事件循环，运行一个任务、清空它的微任务、渲染一帧；以及一个丢掉七帧的长任务。隐藏类和内联缓存，带键的列表和信号（signal）。还有缓存、源，以及一个从光的物理推导出来的对比度。贯穿其中的是一个想法：浏览器在一个16毫秒的帧之内，尽可能少做工作，尽可能晚做工作。

2538e6040da3.en: Where this comes back. Part 43 designs the APIs a web page calls, and keeps them compatible as they change. Part 44 measures whether a faster page changes what people do, with controlled experiments. Parts 45 and 48 put caches and content delivery at the scale of the planet. Part 51 opens the rasterizer and the GPU. And Parts 54 and 55 ask what it would take to trust a compiler, including the one inside a JavaScript engine.
2538e6040da3.zh: 这些内容会在哪里再出现。第43部分设计网页调用的 API，并在它们变化时保持兼容。第44部分用对照实验来衡量更快的页面是否会改变人们的行为。第45和第48部分把缓存和内容分发放到全球的规模上。第51部分打开光栅化器和 GPU。第54和第55部分则追问：要怎样才能信任一个编译器，包括 JavaScript 引擎里的那一个。

a43e046c171e.en: In practice. Measure performance on real users' devices, ship less JavaScript, and keep every task short enough that input never waits. Defer scripts, preload what the first paint needs, and size images to the screen. Give assets names that contain their hashes and cache them forever, and keep the HTML's lifetime short. Escape everything you insert into a page, set a strict content security policy, and mark cookies SameSite. And use real buttons and links before reaching for ARIA, make every action reachable from the keyboard, and keep text contrast at four and a half to one or more.
a43e046c171e.zh: 实践中。在真实用户的设备上测量性能，少发 JavaScript，让每个任务都足够短，使输入永远不必等待。延迟脚本，预加载首次绘制需要的东西，按屏幕大小提供图片。给静态资源起包含其哈希值的名字，并永久缓存它们，同时让 HTML 的有效期保持很短。对插入页面的一切内容都进行转义，设置严格的内容安全策略，并把 cookie 标记为 SameSite。还有，先用真正的按钮和链接，再考虑 ARIA；让每个操作都能用键盘完成；让文字对比度保持在4.5比1或以上。

626dcb477fdc.en: Six problems, with full solutions in the part's notes. Pause on any of them. The fifth is a build problem: give our toy browser flexbox, and render a navigation bar that shrinks as the window narrows. The last, marked with a star, is a research problem: incremental flex layout with intrinsic sizes, whose cost is bounded by the change, with a lower bound to match.
626dcb477fdc.zh: 六道习题，完整解答在这一部分的笔记里。你可以在任何一道上暂停。第五道是一道构建题：给我们的玩具浏览器加上 flexbox，并渲染一个随窗口变窄而收缩的导航栏。最后一道标有星号，是一道研究题：带固有尺寸的增量 flex 布局，其代价以变化为界，并给出一个相匹配的下界。

2c5a4b232d76.en: Next time, Part 43: APIs and services. When a program is split across machines, every call becomes a message that can be lost, duplicated or delayed. We derive the wire formats that carry them, make operations safe to retry, build exactly-once out of at-least-once and deduplication, and keep services from overwhelming each other.
2c5a4b232d76.zh: 下一次，第43部分：API 与服务。当一个程序被拆分到多台机器上，每次调用都变成一条可能丢失、重复或延迟的消息。我们会推导出承载这些消息的线路格式，让操作可以安全地重试，用“至少一次”加上去重构建出“恰好一次”，并防止服务彼此压垮。

9bd24692775d.en: The books and papers this part follows are on screen and in the notes. Thank you for watching.
9bd24692775d.zh: 这一部分所依据的书籍和论文，都在屏幕上和笔记里。感谢观看。
